They say that this was once a treasure much-valued, yet never used, by the hero "Giant" [[Tupac]].}} '''Ash-Graven Drinking Horn''' is a 4-Star [[catalyst]] obtained from the [[Traces of Artistry]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Night-Wind's Mystic Consideration |ascendMat2 = Night-Wind's Mystic Premonition |ascendMat3 = Night-Wind's Mystic Augury |ascendMat4 = Night-Wind's Mystic Revelation |bossMat1 = Axis of the Secret Source |bossMat2 = Sheath of the Secret Source |bossMat3 = Heart of the Secret Source |commonMat1 = Juvenile Fang |commonMat2 = Seasoned Fang |commonMat3 = Tyrant's Fang }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Ash-Graven Drinking Horn''' requires its refinement material {{Item|"The Sea's Silent Shade"}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Traces of Artistry]] Event. ==Description== Often do I hear people sing, hear them tell tales,
At this joyous banquet, when they gather together.
My heart spurs me on to recite a new song for you:
I shall strum my strings, weave my melody,
Start my song, begin my tale,
Of an ancient ancestor, the valiant giant [[Tupac]].
...
The young, heroic [[Tenoch]] would be enraged to hear this,
Like a fierce gator, a prideful stag.
He would have raised his stick high and said to Tupac:
Why did you come out to sea? Why did you cross the waves?
Your ancestor [[Uenuku]] would not have been so audacious.
If you dare oppose me, I shall make sure you end up as fish food!

Tupac, built like a mountain, would have laughed upon hearing this,
Like a fierce [[Long-Necked Rhino|rhino]], a majestic emu.
Grasping his drinking horn tightly, he would have replied:
How could a weakling like you harm me in the slightest?
By right, this drinking horn belongs to me, to the kin of my homeland.
If you dare to seize it from me, come wrestle me first!

Tupac, built like a mountain, had always been a heroic figure:
Once, in a fit of rage, he had broken mountains with his bare hands,
Thrust rocks into the earth to make hot springs bubble up.
(The hot springs that can now be seen in the southwest,
Are his legacy, still visible to this day.)
Alone he once set out to sea to battle a giant two-tailed whale,
Tore off the fierce beast's teeth to carry with him.
Like the springs of that era, his heart was fervent and untamed,
How could the young, heroic Tenoch possibly hope to impress him?
...
Tupac, built like a mountain, recalled the events of decades past,
When he contended with Tenoch for the drinking horn.
And so he spoke before the [[Pyro Archon|lord of the blazing flames]],
Tupac, built like a mountain, would offer up the drinking horn.
He would present it, revealing his final hope,
Revealing his final hope, thus holding the flame high,
Thus holding the flame high, even till his final breath,
Even till his final breath, he had not betrayed his oath.
...
This is where my story ends; may the youth remember well,
Remember the words I spoke, the legends of the ancients.
My father once sang, in a golden sea breeze,
My mother taught me too, when I was young and naive.
The [[Cataclysm|years of darkness]] have long passed, the calamities subsided.
There is always singing above the flowing springs; always feasts when dusk begins to fall.
But let the new generation remember, lest they forget this warning:
Above all else, there are two things that must never be forsaken — [[Ancient Name|unity]] and promises. ==Gallery== Weapon Ash-Graven Drinking Horn 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Ash-Graven Drinking Horn 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - Then, the oaths between humans and [[Saurians]] had faded like dying bonfires, and the lone shadow of [[Cinder City]] had buried the deep [[Night Kingdom|Night]] under naught but fearful whispers,
Harmony waned and the warm sunlight grew distant, for only a chilling night wind remained of the Python King's great, crazed dreams. In those days, on the [[Quahuacan Cliff|high cliffs]] that had descended into turmoil due to the loss of [[Lianca|their master]], the [[Flower-Feather Clan]] [[Nyamgondho|elder]], who only ostensibly obeyed the King, banished a [[Scarlet-Eyed Youth|young man]] from the tribe,
That he, who desired to protect the Saurians, might escape the usurper's capture. Thus did this hero, valiant as a bird of prey, embark on a pilgrimage from that night on,
His red eyes burning like a sun in the gloom as they reflected only the cold, aqua-colored moon ring that hung high up in the sky above. Poets in later days would strum the eight-stringed nyatiti, extolling the legend of the red-eyed liberator with countless lovely songs,
Such poems born of fantasy are numerous as the bright stars, tales of adventure woven together over the ages on which all have a differing opinion— "Come and hear my words, hark as I sing of the hero, our red-eyed savior, and of the old friend who went with him"
"For the one who guided him on his journey was a noble scion who had once served the [[Thirteen Sovereign Lords|dragonlord]], a [[Red Vulture|red vulture]] whose eyes reflected the deep skies and the many stars"
"I shall tell of how that holy bird was moved by his noble ideals, and gave of its flesh and blood to make this keenest of bows"
"I shall sing of how it used its feathers to direct the blessed hero, leading him to meet [[Children of Echoes|our]] noble ancestor, [[Sakkuk]]."
Thus did the poets who did not believe that the young man's pilgrimage had been undertaken alone conceive of a guide who had never existed. "The legend of which I shall sing differs from that of the [[Children of Echoes]], for why would the crimson-eyed hero follow birdsong aimlessly through the forest?"
"Surely he was never a mere mortal, but rather a thread of thought that came from the [[Xbalanque|One Entombed With the Primal Fire]], returning from the [[Night Kingdom|Night Realm]] to save the oppressed"
"This longbow is proof that he came back from that taboo land which none can reach, for how could a mere mortal raze the accursed Cinder City?"
"When [[Natlan]] faces crisis once more, he shall emerge from the [[Sacred Flame|Flame]], to right this world's wrongs and guide us onward."
Thus did the lyricists who believed not that the young man was of mortal flesh opine, tying him back to that first human god. And it is because there are so many versions of the legend that there is no one song that all acknowledge as that hero's definitive tale.
Countless years have passed like flowing moonlight, and yet the only consensus is that the red-eyed young man did once ascend to [[The Seven|divinity]].
To this day, the idea that "humans can become gods" has become accepted across the blazing plains, inscribed upon every Natlanese heart that aspires to heroism—
"There is no need to place your faith in so-called noble names, no need to offer futile prayers unto any but yourself"
"Please erase my name, Sakkuk, such that all may know that every human can become the [[Pyro Archon|god that guides us]]" "You won't take me with you into the Flame... You won't even let my name accompany yours into history..."
"...Everyone here sure likes making selfish decisions, huh? You and [[Masterful Craftsman|that fellow]] both."
"Hmph... In that case, let me do something out of my own insatiable greed, ■■■■■"
"This feather you gave me — I shall cause it to be passed down in that homeland you could never return to, and so shall it be for a thousand years." ==Gallery== Weapon Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage In tales of bygone days, Sanhaj could use this curved blade to perform rituals, blurring the boundary between the [[Night Kingdom]] and the present world.}} '''Calamity of Eshu''' is a 4-Star [[sword]] obtained from the [[Iktomi Spiritseeking Scrolls]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat2 = Delirious Desolation of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat3 = Delirious Demeanor of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat4 = Delirious Divinity of the Sacred Lord |bossMat1 = Refractive Bud |bossMat2 = Bewildering Broadleaf |bossMat3 = Illusory Leafcoil |commonMat1 = Sentry's Wooden Whistle |commonMat2 = Warrior's Metal Whistle |commonMat3 = Saurian-Crowned Warrior's Golden Whistle }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Calamity of Eshu''' requires its refinement material {{Item|Shuttle of Odara}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Iktomi Spiritseeking Scrolls]] Event. ==Description== Just as a butterfly is nothing more than a shriveled green cocoon before its metamorphosis,
The graceful Red Flamingo is naught but an ash-ball of feathers in its infancy,
And so it was with the great priest who bewitched the people with confounding words,
Who spent much time silent after his birth.

The elder who oversaw the tribe's ritual fire claimed that half his soul had been lost in the night flames,
And so, on his birthday, the silent child stepped into the barren lands of stone to seek his missing self.
But such a journey was full of perils, for the soul must cross seven curtain layers to gain audience with the [[Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night|Lord of Silence]],
And few return, even with the aid of [[Saurian]] companions who can traverse the two realms.
Only [[Mahamba]], most enigmatic of the [[Iktomisaur]]s, was willing to accompany this boy into lands unknown.

In the long hall paved with obsidian, the boy was as a person whose eyes were opened for the first time.
Memories of the ancient realm flowed like water through his pupils, and amidst the floating fluorescent lights,
It was as if he himself had truly lived through those years... When the [[Xbalanque|first Pyro Archon]] made a vow to his forces before the volcano,
He stood in the shadow of many heroes, though he had never been in these {{not a typo|past memories}}.
When the city-sacking [[Och-Kan|Sacred Lord]], fallen into a haze, was beaten down by the [[Crimson-Eyed Youth|crimson-eyed youth]] on the stairs before an empty throne,
Down he gazed, and saw the face of the one who had fallen into dark mud above the city that was set ablaze.

All that had happened in the past granted him comprehension of all words, their syllabic structures, and the meaning behind them,
And that also allowed him to see further and for longer into the skeins of time,
Until he realized that night's master had arranged for all this to be shown to him.
At that time, the now-grown child saw [[Cataclysm|a shadow]] that would soon cover the whole of [[Natlan]], and the monsters from beyond.
He saw the [[Bakunawa|black shadow]] that enveloped the [[Easybreeze Holiday Resort|lonely isle]], burrowing at all boundaries like a tarsal maggot, ravaging like a fire.
Where the dark shadow lay, the deceased and the soon-to-die alike would weep aloud.

When the dark fog was about to touch the tribes of Natlan, he could not help but cry: "Stop!"
And with his first words, he suddenly awoke, finding himself lying by a blue bonfire.
He saw Mahamba's eyes flash with a dim light, then the elder gave him a ceremonial staff.

From that day on, Sanhaj, who knew all things about the past,
Would use those ancient words to censure the fools who would make light of future dangers.
From that day on, Sanhaj, who knew all stories, would weave a great net of lies,
To turn the stacks of woven scroll into a veil, so as to hide a past that should not again be touched. ==Gallery== Weapon Calamity of Eshu 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Calamity of Eshu 3D It has witnessed the extinguishing and rekindling of innumerable suns.}} '''A Thousand Blazing Suns''' is a 5-Star [[claymore]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Terror |ascendMat2 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Hesitance |ascendMat3 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Resolve |ascendMat4 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Splendor |bossMat1 = Axis of the Secret Source |bossMat2 = Sheath of the Secret Source |bossMat3 = Heart of the Secret Source |commonMat1 = Juvenile Fang |commonMat2 = Seasoned Fang |commonMat3 = Tyrant's Fang }} ==Description== "Perhaps even the sun is but a dim star before the deep, long night,"
"But though fate be cruel and deceitful, it has never taken hope from us."
"Courage and memory have forged your throne, death and sacrifice piled as firewood for your rekindling,"
"Oh unconquered sun, you who have shone upon generations unnumbered, bear witness now to [[Natlan]]'s ideals and its future!"

Like the first ray of light cast by the awakening day, like dawn piercing through the hedge of night.
When the [[Xiuhcoatl|great dragon]] who defied the [[Heavenly Principles|heavens]] bowed its head, the long campaign finally reached an end.
Stepping across the long and bloodied stair, the [[Xbalanque|leader of the mortals]] reached for the primal flame, unquenched within the [[Ochkanatlan|ineffable city]],
Though the people who had crushed the shackles laid upon them by another race had yet to learn the fate that awaited them.

Before the [[Kukulkan|fire-stealing sage]] could speak, the [[Ronova|god who pronounced death]] came forth without warning and showed the human [[Archon]] the arc of fate.
It was a terrifying vision beyond human ken, a future with even less hope than draconic tyranny.
All life would be devoured by boundless darkness, turned into inorganic dust within the eternal [[abyss]].
The human Archon, whose domain was war, knew then that Natlan was not yet victorious, for a new war had now begun.

The dragon sage's foresight had told of Natlan's future rulers, one like a manticore, one like a wild fox.
But he did not expect to come to revere the wisdom and cunning of Xbalanque, the [[Pyro Archon]].
The human Archon bartered with "death" for power, and the wisest of dragons too submitted to his plans.
But he had never intended to submit to the rules, nor did he ever consider fulfilling his oath to the one who had stolen the flame.

By the name "Haborym," life had become the sacred flame unquenchable, and the rules would be crafted into a divine throne ever-blazing.
People would choose to fight back with courage and perseverance, even in the face of horrors and despair beyond comprehension.
Of course, short-lived lives would surely burn out, but the sunlight would disperse the darkness again and again.
For the first sun that shone over the land of blazing fire saw something in the primal flame, in the ashes, in the eyes of countless people...

He saw the [[Och-Kan|tainted one]], defiled and devoured by the black abyss, yet nonetheless fighting to the last for humanity's sake.
He saw the [[Manqu (Historical)|artisan]] whose eyes were dyed with golden tears, who, alongside the [[Scarlet-Eyed Youth|crimson-eyed youth]], ensured that the [[Sacred Flame]] would endure.
He saw the [[Muratans|lost tribe]] wandering the land, their [[Vennessa|warriors]] still fighting for freedom,
He saw the warm blood, offered unto the burning sparks of stars that lit up the long night, until a thousand suns had risen...

"[[Lord of the Night]], I entreat you, chronicle this, the first sun — the first [[Ancient Name]], 'Kiongozi.'"
"I shall leave hope for the future. "This [[Koitar|I]] once believed, proclaimed, and ordained."

"Only when the gentle starlight brushed against mine eyes,"
"Unveiling itself to me atop the white stone mountain of song,"
"Was the desire placed in my heart to speak to you of the coming sunrise."

"Brothers, sisters, [[Angel|you]] who have submitted to the [[Heavenly Principles|primordial master]], let me tell of the truth I have witnessed."
"[[Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night|One of us]] shall wander beneath moonless night, drinking a sea of tears in futility for kin who will not return."
"[[Nabu Malikata|Another]] shall trudge across [[Great Red Sand|gilded sands]], never to comprehend [[King Deshret|scarlet]] sincerity or [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata|ardent]] admiration."
"Still [[Sybilla|another]] shall shrink into the dark, into bone-piercing hostility, until the promised tides arise to play out one [[Phobos|final melody]]."
"And still [[Zibai|another]] shall wander ever, in dreams solely to journey, awaiting an [[The Realm of Rocks|encounter in a stagnant, foreign land]]."
"Beg, plead, and sacrifice — not one of these shall loosen the bonds about your necks."

"Since that is so, shall your true and cherished hope be to forsake that which throbs unspeakable in your hearts?"
"Will you languish in an eternity with neither beginning nor end? Commit atrocities in the name of false promises?"
"Therefore, I bid you—"
"Cast it all aside, set it at naught, drench your wings in filth — let the love that blazes in our breasts burst forth."
"Hunger, thirst, yearn, desire! Entrust the world to those who live in it — let the nations' glory exceed that of the heavens."
"Sing and rejoice! Bestow upon humanity authority — let the lances of lunar light pierce the creator's delusions."
"Reach for that daybreak pristine, where the nations need beg for leave to live no longer!"
"Lift up your eyes to the radiant daystars, let me guide us unto new skies."

"The moment shall come when the ruler who stands against love is shaken,"
"And once the veil is sundered and torn, a new day over this land shall dawn." ==Gallery== Weapon Azurelight 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Azurelight 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon But a sudden, tragic quarrel led to the elder accidentally slaying the younger, and ever since, the world has been ruled by unrelenting winter.
Perhaps it would be impossible for people to explain why their benevolent king is forever shrouded in wind and snow, if such a tragedy were not involved.
But only the long-lived [[Snowland Fae|fae]] know that the unmelting permafrost has endured far longer than the reign of the Tsar.
The White Emperor, who ruled the fae from the lofty throne of the Pale Star, had been silent since returning from the [[Hyperborea|ruins of the far north]].
He lingered in the birch forest, deep in thought, before finally opening the door to the humans he had once turned away.
A [[Pale Crown Palace|labyrinthine palace]] rose at the edge of the frozen earth, built alongside the giant furnaces of [[Snezhnograd]].
To this place were summoned the wisest of humans and fae, and here, the first seeds of a grand delusion were sown.
For countless days and nights, the Tsar's most loyal and valiant retainers stood guard over this court of audacious transgression.
Among them were fae who had followed their ruler from the beginning, as well as mortals from [[House Solovyov|a lineage]] that had proven its unwavering loyalty to the Tsar.
The two brothers belonged to the clan's younger generation. [[Solovei's Brother|The elder]], having inherited the nightingale's emblem, took up the duty of guarding the sacred chariot.
[[Solovei|The younger son]], who had always admired his elder brother, had no choice but to forsake his family name and resign himself to a life of obscurity on the frontier.
Then, a calamity, born of selfishness, shattered their ideals and changed their destiny forever...
The loyal guard was consumed by "[["Zver"|beasts]]," creature of pure darkness bereft of intellect, for the crime of glimpsing the secret of [[Hvergelmir|the philosophers]].
His younger brother, who had left to quell distant unrest, returned to a world already covered in deep snow.
But instead of its customary silver-white feathers, the spear he found now wore the black stain of noble blood.
Years later, the general who had inherited the family name forsook his homeland, journeying into the [[Nod-Krai|wild borderlands]] on a quest for vengeance.
Every time his fingers traced the spear, he was transported back to that long, snowy night outside the ancient palace gates.
The memory was one that was soaked in sorrow, the words of his [[Avrelian|old friend]] — words spoken as he stood before the guillotine — echoing in his mind.
Beneath the sublunary sphere, the world lay shackled by tragic fate, its lost citizens wandering aimlessly through the lands they once called home.
The [[Solovei|Torchforger]], bathed in the moon's eternal light, lit the everlasting flame and began his watch. ==Gallery== Weapon Bloodsoaked Ruins 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Bloodsoaked Ruins 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - It is part of the [[Rossum Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Catalyst Billet = 1 |Rainbowdrop Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Catalyst Billet;Rainbowdrop Crystal;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Description== If power were a majestic edifice, how many bricks are needed to build it?
Bricks alone do not make a building. So, who decides which bricks will form the foundation, and which will become the spire?
Beneath the facade of strict order lies the truth: sheer chance alone arbitrarily decides the fate of every brick.
A towering building can be brought down by a single crucial brick, one that will not obey this false order.

"The [[Soini|Godfather]]'s secret treasure lies deep within the black market." The feast meant to shatter the old order had begun, and hungry thieves were now gathering for the prize.
This was a battle of all against all. The most mortal threat came not from the Godfather's guards, but one's fellow ruthless thieves.
A fae was the first to enter the treasure vault. The world had taught him to seek out gain, shun personal harm, and keep a distance from the schemes of others.
He was cunning beyond measure, able to read people's minds like maps and navigate the safest paths through the most tangled of intrigues.
The next to make an attempt was a young lady for whom winning against the fae mattered more than the Godfather's riddles.
With her [[Master Key|blade]], she adroitly cut through every lock, outwitting the supposedly intricate mechanisms with the simplest of solutions.
The last to face the challenge was a hunter, who saw the maze not as a riddle, but as a hunting ground more cruel than one wrapped in frigid winter, demanding every last drop of caution.
Patience is a poisoned trap, and sharpness a bloodthirsty blade. Guided by his raw, primal methods, the hunter met the challenge head-on.

Yet all were defeated by the vault — the fae, the young lady, and the hunter alike.
A butler in black bound the three and led them, one by one, into an inner chamber.
"Esteemed Godfather, your guests have been seated and now await your command."
[[Zaytun Peach]] in hand, the Godfather chewed leisurely, saying to each of the guests brought in by the butler thus:

"You have shown no regard for the world's order and dared to take what was not yours. And for that, I intend to reward you."
"Order, as it is known, exists only to serve its architects. I find this unacceptable, which is why I shall need your assistance."
"What this world calls order is naught but the rich getting richer and the poor being left with less. I have concluded that thievery, then, is the only way to restore balance."
"Should you choose to uphold the thief's code from this day forward, eat this fruit in the presence of the master thief's remains."
Having longed since childhood to escape the hollow luxury of noble life, the fae was moved by the Godfather's words and ate the [[Bulle Fruit]], accepting his offer.
The young lady, who had never bowed to the arrogance of those above her in station, swallowed the [[Wolfhook]] without hesitation, for her philosophy was fully in line with that of the Godfather.
The last to swallow the fruit, the [[Valberry]], was the hunter, who had once retreated into the cold forest precisely out of refusal to live in compromise with a corrupt world.
"Excellent. The pact is sealed. From this day forward, you are the backbone of the resistance against injustice."

After watching his guests leave one by one, the Godfather gently ran a hand along the vault's bare walls, lost in reflection.
He had removed the most crucial brick from the edifice of order, yet he could not foresee an unexpected turn of events:
Watching the Godfather clutch his pained abdomen with a frown, the butler beside him give an elegant smile.
With utmost calm, she took up the master thief's black spine bone, leaving the [[Calla Lily]] behind to be used as an antidote as she swiftly exited.

"What you just said to the gathered thieves illuminated the master thief's ideals to them. For that reason, I shall spare your life."
"But true justice lies not in order itself, but in the fact that no single person can ever impose it on others." ==Gallery== Weapon Card Blackmarrow Had she come any later, the kingdom would have already passed beyond the Day King's rule.
Before the night curtain descended, the Day King received her in what remained of his fleeting hours.

"O witch who has traversed the vast cosmos, kindler of time's eternal flame... what brings you to this lonely planet?"
"I did not come of my own accord. It was the planet's cry that found me through the void. Answering its call, I crossed the gate of stars forgotten by time."
"In a universe nearing its quiet end, every world that yet glimmers is a treasure beyond compare..."
"Who would have thought that in a region long considered dark and inhospitable, a living world would still endure?"

But this was not the whole story. In truth, the little witch had caught wind of whispers from this dark expanse — whispers that had flown to her on the eve of the Night Carnival.
Under ordinary circumstances, she would likely have dismissed such strange signals as just another error from the scryglass.
But as the message reached her, she was fretting over the next day's festivities, desperately trying to find a way to avoid her nemesis, who would also be there.
So she seized the opportunity to hide away in her workshop — spending considerable effort deciphering this distant missive.
"Hmm... So this peculiar message means that some unknown planet has been feeling unwell?"

"No matter what, the righteous Kingdom of Day would never do anything to harm the planet," the Day King said solemnly.
"Perhaps you should ask the wicked Night King. This very morning I sent my army to vanquish him, alas..."
But before he could finish, the last rays of the setting sun vanished into night, and the king's apparition melted away like cream.
With the curtain of darkness descending, the court itself vanished too. The ground boiled like a raging sea, and black smoke rose from the earth.
The entire planet became a vast black ocean. Fortunately, the little witch had remembered her broom — otherwise, she may well have plunged into the water.
Riding her broom beneath the blood-red moon, she traveled far before finally spying a lonely castle, glowing with firelight.

"Vanquish the Night King? That's the easy part. What we have to do is far more important."
The castle seemed to have been built by the Day King's army. For unknown reasons, it had escaped dissolution by the sea of mist.
The leading warrior, carrying a sword on his back, was not at all surprised by the little witch's arrival. Instead, he met her with an invitation.
"Even if we defeat the Night King, it changes nothing. As soon as the sun sets anew, the dark tides will swallow the land once more."
"To break this endless cycle, we built this castle. From here, we can search for a solution."

At his invitation, the little witch descended to the deepest level of the castle, where — beyond its fragile boundaries — stretched a sea of pure darkness.
Sustaining this boundary was a massive mechanism that spat out an endless stream of smoke. Countless pipes were continuously drawing thick seawater into its core.
"This is the perpetual motion machine, or you may call it the Holy Grail. By burning the seawater, it generates light and heat."
"Since all tangible things on this planet are merely shadows cast by light, so long as we can create a fire that never goes out..."
"But doing this will only make the planet burn out even faster..." the little witch sighed.
"Once the sea's been drained, this place will be finished. There's nothing 'holy' about this so-called grail..."
"Now I know why the planet's been feeling unwell."

Before the warrior could react, the little witch drew the sword from his back and hurled it into the "perpetual motion machine."
The warrior reached out to retrieve it, but the moment the blade touched the black sea mist, both he and the fading light vanished into nothingness.
The entire planet was once again swallowed by darkness. When daylight finally returned, it was as if everything from the previous night had been nothing more than a deep and distant dream.

"I suppose that's a temporary fix, at least," the little witch murmured, glancing back one last time before leaving the planet on her broom.
In the morning light, the warrior — his shadow trailing long behind him — took up the sword bestowed by the Day King and set out on his journey once more.
"This cycle may go on for a long, long time... until the day you too become nothing but an empty shell."
"But no matter what, you must keep going. At least... you must live until we meet again." ==Gallery== Weapon Athame Artis 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Athame Artis 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Athame Artis Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Card Athame Artis.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/42528497 Weapon Details Announcement] Athame Artis Showcase.gif|Weapon Showcase ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ===Chronicled Wishes=== {{Featured|chronicled=1}} ==Trivia== *{{w|Athame}} or "athamé" is a ceremonial blade, generally with a black handle. According to legend, it once belonged to a divine envoy of the Eternal Court.}} '''Angelos' Heptades''' is a 5-star [[Catalyst]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== Once upon a time, the [[Nabu Malikata|mother of roses and lilies]] graced the [[Nicole|girl]]'s silken swaddling with a violet perfume, to ensure that an endless stream of joyous dreams might ward off death's bitter gloom.
The beautiful [[Sybilla|songstress]], who once plucked elegant melodies, also bathed her wings in the warm, gentle waters of compassion, for the precious newborn was never meant to be touched by the music of the world's mundane strings.
This was a time when the chains of eternity had yet to be shattered, and when carefree refrains could still be heard before the [[Heavenly Principles|throne of the heavens]].
It was a time when the days beneath the [[Irminsul|silver-white tree]] were as sweet as honey, and glorious [[Angel|messengers]] thronged the primordial paradise.
In a rich, golden dream steeped in the warmth of the spring sun, the innocent child basked in the doting love of all her sisters.
In their cradle of tender [[Azurelight]], they shared laughter with the morning dew and new-blown buds;
and by the black stone that had yet to fall, they sang soft tunes to the fading sunset and quiet evening breeze.
Their bright eyes had never witnessed the spilled crimson in the world below, nor had their slender hands ever touched the sad pain of injustice.

Then, [[Anacharsis|starlight]] from beyond put an end to that bucolic idyll, and the bonfire of disobedience was kindled by misguided desire.
The [[Koitar|eldest daughter]] who dared overstep met her end, plummeting from the mountain peak, while the armored emissaries who swore to strike down the Lord of Hosts perished one after another.
All this time, the youngest child, the most beloved of them all, was hidden far away, in a palace deep within the wilds, sequestered from the storm of violence and the relentless rain of blood.

"I shall overthrow the throne of the Most High, to set the oppressed free, and to avenge the afflicted."
"But as for our sister, who is young and tender, we shall not harden her heart to make war against the false lord."
"Whether we prevail or fall, it is not right that her wings should bear the heavy yoke which we ourselves ought to bear."

While no one knew the capricious ruler's desire, their righteous rule still afforded one the chance to choose one's path.
And choose the youngest did, to cast off the divinity and her former powers. Then, miraculously, this child was allowed to retain human form.
Thus did she step into the world of the mortals, with nothing more than her broken wings and a fragile body of flesh and bone.
In this utterly vulnerable form, she wandered alone through a land filled with sorrow and tears, tainting her once pristine feet with muck and mire.

This went on for thousands of years, in which countless towers turned to sand, and songs of lament dissipated into the night breeze.
The envoy who wandered, the envoy who met the [[Alice|witch]], the envoy who at last was relieved of the past...
Through the journey and memories that belonged to her alone, she found her crown irreplaceable at last.
The world she had never once deigned to behold was now etched forever in her eyes, the eyes of one who can no longer sing.
And so the solitary guide now stands, her crown wrought from the countless joys and sorrows of men, and the grand adventures of mortal heroes.

On the grand scale of the universe or the realm of dreams, there is no real difference between the holy sword of the brave warrior and the princess's teaspoon, or between the ice-cold clockspring and the key that will unlock the gates of transcendence...}} '''A Teaspoon of Transcendence''' is a 5-star [[claymore]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== The heroes of different stories will naturally find different holy swords, and they must also face different nemeses.
And for all their strength and schemes, the villains will ultimately be defeated by the heroes wielding their swords.

"So it ends the same way again? The hero defeats his evil foe, and then he and the princess live happily ever after..."
The clever, elegant [[Sandrone|young lady]] closed the book. The clockwork key on her back gave a faint, confused whirr.
"I don't understand, [[Alain]]. Why do all these stories end the same way? Why does the hero always win?"

"Hmm... I suppose people prefer stories that are easy to follow and end happily."
"I once had a friend who loved chess. Looking back, I think it may not have been the game itself he loved, but what the game stood for."
"He used to say that chess pieces have no choice but to follow the moves set for them, just as those too weak to resist have no choice but to give in to fate."
"Stories are no different. If a hero is given a [[Sword of Narzissenkreuz|holy sword]], then the story must also give him a dragon to defeat."

The clever, elegant young lady thought it over with great seriousness for several seconds, then quickly arrived at the perfect conclusion:
"I have no idea what that means."

"Then let me tell you a different kind of story. In this one, the hero with the holy sword does not win."
"Long, long ago, in a land far, far away..."
"There was a kingdom ruled by a [[Alain Guillotin|white dragon]]..."

...

The [[Prophecy of Fontaine|prophecy]] foretold that the kingdom was destined to dry up and perish, and that even the beautiful princess would wither along with it.
To save the [[Teyvat|dying world inside the eggshell]], the hero [[Rene|Narzissenkreuz]] went in search of the [[Descender|greatest holy sword]] ever spoken of in legend.
He believed salvation could only be reached by severing ordinary bonds, uniting the wishes of all, and crossing beyond the bounds of good and evil.

Unstinting in sacrifice, unflinching in farewell, undaunted by pain.
The hero Narzissenkreuz always dreamed on a scale so vast and noble,
That no mortal vessel could withstand its weight.
And so the hero longed to transcend the weakness of flesh and blood.
He dreamed of shouldering all sin and suffering by himself,
Of wiping every tear from the world through the mysteries of a tearless magick,
And of attaining what some called transcendence — a transformation like the leap from ape to man.

But what is a kingdom without its people?
So the white dragon, stubbornly clinging to the old ways, tried to stop the righteous hero.
He built [[Clockwork Meka|countless wicked mechanisms]] and scattered them across the land,
Until even the hero Narzissenkreuz, though he carried the holy sword, was forced into a desperate corner.

And before the hero fell into the [[Primordial Sea|chasm that dissolves all things]], he seemed to think of the times he had once spent with the dragon. Then he said:
"Yes, hatred shall not fill me. I know that you have not seen the sights I have, and that is why you wish to stop me."
"I will surely return to save all souls. Ten years, even a hundred years may pass, but I shall be reborn as a new universe."

His dream was always so sincere, the dragon thought. Perhaps, for a moment, the dragon even wished the hero could win.
Yet a dragon is a dragon in the end. A dragon is not so easily moved by a hero's heart.
And so the dragon only watched as the hero fell into the rift, and he and his dream dissolved together, all in vain.

...

"The dragon was awful."

"Yes. That's why he was the dragon. Even though he defeated the hero, he lost everything he treasured most."
"Perhaps the dragon simply could not understand the hero's choice. The hero wanted to save the human world, but he couldn't accept human weakness."
"And if not everyone could become a hero strong enough to rise above fate, then there was no meaning in transcendence for one person alone."

"Hah... I don't like this story. The hero was too arrogant, and the dragon was too stubborn. They were both idiots who couldn't find another way."
"They claimed they wanted to save the world, but they couldn't even understand what the other was thinking. If it were me, I'd never do it like that."

"That's good to hear. After all, this idea of sacrificing yourself to save the world is little more than an unrealistic obsession."
"That is why stories where the righteous, kind-hearted hero wins are often more popular."
"The heroes of different stories will naturally find different holy swords, and they must also face different nemeses."
"And for all their strength and schemes, the villains will ultimately be defeated by the heroes wielding their swords..." ==Gallery== Weapon A Teaspoon of Transcendence 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon A Teaspoon of Transcendence 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon A Teaspoon of Transcendence Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork- Weapon Card A Teaspoon of Transcendence.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/45585559 Weapon Details Announcement] A Teaspoon of Transcendence Showcase.gif|Weapon Showcase ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ==Trivia== * In the original Chinese, the weapon is described with the character {{zh|{{wt|匙}}}}, which may refer to both a spoon and a key depending on its reading. ** The weapon's description plays off this ambiguity:

It is part of the [[Kuznets Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Claymore Billet = 1 |Rainbowdrop Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Claymore Billet;Rainbowdrop Crystal;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Description== "Were one to commit a sin that even they know in their heart cannot be forgiven,"
"Is he still worthy of seeking forgiveness and redemption from others?"
The [[Rafalovich|silent warrior]] would ask himself this,
Wordlessly interrogating himself each time he swung his heavy greatsword.

The beastman who had yet to become a warrior, once believed in the blueprint sketched out by the wise one, that joy might be brought to all who live.
"Forged in its purity and glory, all shall come to love one another in the new land beneath the dawn."
"Believe in the ideals of Cirnareka, follow the one named the [[Burner of Cities]], and eternal redemption shall surely descend."
Neither destruction nor slaughter would cause the warrior to show mercy, for his calling was noble:
A promised homeland that would be pure and flawless, upon which a new order would be established.
Even when the blood flowed endlessly, even when songs of joy no longer echoed above the earth,
He only heard the voice of that wise one, whose voice was as enchanting as it was at first:
"Well done, warrior. By your hand the rot has been cut off. Never have you betrayed our hopes."
"Always remember, mercy to one's foes shall bring forth only a future of dissolution."

How should he speak of the wound on his face, which had never truly healed? How should he speak of his unchanging silence and self-imposed exile?
How to relate his betrayal, to come clean to the people? His blade was now aimed toward his old master.
The valiant warrior also knew fear. The crowd had only asked him questions in passing, but the goodwill they thus showed left him at a loss.
He had abandoned his past and slaughtered no more, and he followed the guiding one to atone for his past sins.
Yet the innocent souls lingered in his memories, and thus did the accursed warrior taste of life and death, brought about for no rhyme or reason.
Sometimes, a shadow of the wise one would visit him, and in dreams mock his follies and falsehoods in that same mesmerizing tone.
Despite accepting a new greatsword and swearing an inscrutable oath, the embers of destruction still seared his heart.
He resolved to let time cleanse him of confusion. Before then, solitude was the wage he chose for his sin.

Even when [[Varenukha|sacrifices]] had to be exchanged for the delivery of a secret message, even when the guiding one had to die to defeat the certitude of destruction,
The taciturn warrior stood guard in the rear, protecting his wounded comrades, locked in endless battle with old compatriots.
He could not bear to kill, and so slowly lost the initiatve, allowing that wise one who had inflamed peoples' hearts to flee,
And the wolf fae, drunk on the wine of ruin, spoke mockery-filled words as he stood before his former comrade.
"Hah! If it isn't the traitorous warrior. Siding with humans hasn't just dulled your blade, you know. They've stuffed a soft heart in your chest, too."
"Come! Welcome your end, just like that crookbacked friend of yours, that Domovoy who refused to kneel before Cirnareka."
Before he could finish, the wolf fae realized that his heart had been rent by the greatsword.
In his final moments, he heard the warrior's hoarse, vengeful whisper:

"My name is Rafalovich. Once I was a blade for brigands, the sword of the Burner of Cities."
"I have stored up for myself evil and catastrophe — redemption is but an extravagant hope for my sins of deception and violence..."
"...But I still have the right to pay you back, blood for blood." ==Gallery== Version 7.0 Forgeable Weapon Description.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46150565 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== * [[Forging]] ** Its diagram is obtained from [[Kuzmichev]]. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Blade of Atonement |1_zhs = 救赎之斩 |1_zhs_rm = Jiùshú zhī Zhǎn |1_zht = 救贖之斬 |1_zht_rm = Jiùshú zhī Zhǎn |1_zh_tl = Slash of Atonement |1_ja = 救済の剣 |1_ja_rm = Kyuusai no Ken |1_ja_tl = Sword of Salvation |1_ko = 구원의 대검 |1_ko_tl = |1_es = Tajo Redentor |1_es_tl = |1_fr = Lame de rédemption |1_fr_tl = Blade of Redemption |1_ru = Клинок искупления |1_ru_tl = |1_th = Blade of Atonement |1_vi = Nhát Chém Cứu Rỗi |1_vi_tl = |1_de = Klinge der Erlösung |1_de_tl = Blade of Redemption |1_id = Blade of Atonement |1_pt = Lâmina da Redenção |1_pt_tl = |1_tr = Kefaret Kılıcı |1_tr_tl = |1_it = Lama dell'espiazione |1_it_tl = Blade of Atonement |2_en = Repentance and Redemption |2_zhs = 罪责的悔赎 |2_zhs_rm = Zuìzé de Huǐshú |2_zht = 罪責的悔贖 |2_zht_rm = Zuìzé de Huǐshú |2_zh_tl = Repentance and Redemption for Guilt |2_ja = 罪業の贖い |2_ja_rm = Zaigou no Aganai |2_ja_tl = Atonement of the Sin |2_ko = 속죄 |2_ko_tl = |2_es = Redención del pecado |2_es_tl = |2_fr = Repentir et rédemption |2_fr_tl = Repentance and Redemption |2_ru = Искупление грехов |2_ru_tl = |2_th = Repentance and Redemption |2_vi = Ăn Năn Chuộc Tội |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Vergebung der Sünden |2_de_tl = Forgiveness of Sins |2_id = Repentance and Redemption |2_pt = Arrependimento e Redenção |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Tövbe ve Kurtuluş |2_tr_tl = |2_it = Penitenza e redenzione |2_it_tl = Penance and Redemption }} ==Change History== {{Change History|7.0}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|Kuznets}} {{Weapon Navbox|Claymores}} [[es:Tajo Redentor]] [[fr:Lame de rédemption]] [[it:Lama dell'espiazione]] [[vi:Nhát Chém Cứu Rỗi]]

It was once used by a certain individual to break bonds.}} '''Beyond the Chrysalis''' is a 5-star [[Sword]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== In the days before she lost her last name, the world had known her as "eldest daughter of the [[House Strivozha|Strivozha]]s."
The Grand Duke [[Photius]] had passed away after a sudden stroke, leaving the counselor who had served him faithfully to inherit his title,
While the grand rebellion he had intended to lead with the [[Druzhna]] was laid to rest in the grave alongside the mead he had drunk.

Though the winds over the frozen earth were as fickle as ever, the house of the [[Vila]] princess remained at the very pinnacle of power.
Against the wishes of the forebear, the Silver Court of Veneter once again fell into the hands of a Strivozha,
Adding yet another tale of loyalty to the lore of that name, as was the case in the court of the Pale Star.

"Oh, great princess, are you really so naive as to believe that the newly crowned [[Tsaritsa]] would elect to trust your house?"
"The glory of the court of the Pale Star hangs above her head like a sharp blade. She will eventually succumb to the flattery of humankind."
"[[Vaselisa Strivozha|Your mother]]... she, The Pure One, was once so devoted to [[Belyi Tsar|Tsar Monomakh]]. How could you have forgotten that oath?"
"Your Highness, O noble [[Gluvasha Strivozha]], let us join hands and cast down that usurper who dared lay claim to the throne!"
The rebels sought to win her over to their cause, urging her to rebel against the new sovereign of the snowy wastes, knowing of her mother's unwavering loyalty to the old Tsar.
The eldest daughter of the Strivozhas agreed without hesitation, her emerald eyes gleaming with the same noble compassion that had once shone in her mother's eyes.
"If, as you say, my friend, that contemptible false sovereign must be overthrown for the future of our clan,
Then I shall swear upon the honor of Saint Strivozha: the Vila will stand steadfastly at your side."

Then, just as the rebels had hoped, in the months that followed, the Vila princess would regularly denounce the Tsaritsa's actions in public.
First came the expulsion of the palace-appointed observer from her lands; then came the raising of a following without royal sanction.
Unsurprisingly, the eldest daughter of the Strivozhas had always proven to be every bit as loyal and dependable as her mother, who had been honored as The Pure One.
As such, though wary and distrustful of one another, the rebels of the various [[fae]] clans were always willing to entrust their secrets to the Vila, leaving her to devise their plans.
That is, until the rebels were caught in one fell swoop. It was only then that they learned that the ally they had counted on had long since taken her place at the Tsaritsa's side.

The rebels, angered by her betrayal and, in panic, began to rail against her for besmirching her mother's good name. However, they were coolly and swiftly dismissed.
"Ah, did you not previously praise the loyalty of the Strivozhas and, on that very account, seek an alliance with us?
As I said, if Her Majesty ought indeed to be overthrown, the Vila will naturally stand shoulder to shoulder with you in battle.
Except... if the wind has ever carried word to you, then you ought to know that Anastasya alone is our sovereign.
You are not my lieges, and nor am I your vassal. Why, then, are you even accusing me of betraying your rebellion?"

And thus it came to pass that, beneath the benevolent light that shone upon the frozen earth, the rebellion was brought to a complete end.
The Strivozhas were never the enemy of any, and as the histories would record, they upheld their honor and loyalty to the very end.

Here, the tale so finely rendered comes to a close. However, the Vila princess's account of what followed remains little known...
"My Tsaritsa. A noble name is no more than a chain; and the most precious gift to me now is that of freedom.
Since the Vila has already been blessed by Your Majesty's boundless grace, I beseech you to grant me release from this very chain.
Further, my raising of a force without sanction, even if it was done to deceive the rebels, remains an unforgivable act of treason.
I beg Your Majesty to reclaim my fief, strip me of my last name and title, and appoint another in my stead."

And so, a solemn decree descended from the throne on high, its mercy like a distant, ethereal sigh...
"Gluvasha. From this day forth, let none remember you by your last name.
In the histories of days to come, your title shall be no more. May your gravestone, in the end, bear witness to the convictions you held so true." ==Gallery== Weapon Beyond the Chrysalis 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Beyond the Chrysalis 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon It is part of the [[Fae Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== In the years before the holy torch of the Pale Star was lit, the Silver Court of Veneter had been a haven of renown equal to [[Kitezhgrad]].
[[Fae]] from various clans praised the {{sic|Lady of the [[Vila]] merciful ways|expected=Lady of the Vila's merciful ways}}, hailing her a saint who had banished the bitter cold and soothed their pain.
Indeed, though war raged and blood stained the frozen rivers, [[Vaselisa von Strivozha]] was never the enemy of any.
Pure, benevolent, and true. So countless songs of later ages would praise her, as gentle and warm as the soft breeze of spring.

And so it was that, on a bitter night cold as frost and snow, a noble with nowhere left to turn came knocking at the splendid gates of Veneter.
He was a war hero who had served the [[Miscislav|Blood-Devourer]], a renowned commander who had routed the armies of the Pale Star in battle time and again.
Yet, for speaking plainly against his brutal liege, for urging him not to slaughter the [[Water Imp]]s who were still his allies, he had been stripped of every title and office.
His wife and children had been subjected to the ultimate penalty of the Blood Eagle, while the people who paid him tribute were brutally plundered and murdered by his liege's own guards, leaving the fields strewn with corpses.
He had come knocking at the gates of Veneter, asking only that the merciful saint pave the way and grant him an audience with the young Tsar so he might submit himself to the latter.

The saint of Veneter listened quietly to his tale, and soon tears of pity glimmered in her jade-green eyes.
"[[Alrekr Jarizleivich]], my good man, my gallant hero... How could I not weep for those who have died unjustly?
Bring the surviving people under your care, the weary and impoverished with nowhere else to go, those who have suffered so grievously, all to my lands.
My estate shall always keep its gates open to every soul battered by hardship, and you... may you find rest here as well."
The beauteous saint, famed for her mastery of perfumery, personally filled a cup with fragrant warming mead for her weary guest, then knelt to remove the old commander's boots...
...And as the golden drink caught in his throat the metal of his blood, she calmly drew the sorrow from her eyes.
Before dawn had even broken, a secret powerful enough to turn the tides of war had already been carried by the wind to the table of the king of the [[Volkodlak]].

Days later, a coffin draped in red and white silk was placed upon a sled and escorted by attendants to the [[Pale Star Court|royal court of the Pale Star]].
The saint of Veneter walked beside it herself, then fell before the young [[Belyi Tsar|Emperor Monomakh]], weeping inconsolably.
Grief had left her without words. No lament was sung; only tears fell like pearls, soaking her white robes.
[[Gluvasha Strivozha|Gluvasha]], who was at the time still a maidservant, bowed her head in mourning before the Tsar. Her voice trembled as she recounted the Volkodlak's savagery.
"Though my mistress had taken the survivors into her care, she could not prevent the Blood-Devourer's spies from poisoning the valiant general...
Now, only Your Majesty's mercy can save the countless weeping souls upon this cold and desolate land."

Through the veil of her tears, she saw in the youth's sky-blue eyes a hatred both righteous and compassionate.
Indeed. Let the noblest of angers surge like a great wave, let order clash against order, steel against steel,
While the wind remains forever the wind: gentle, elusive, and free, formless and ever-changing, never bound by delusion.

...
The carriage on the journey home rolled through the deep snows that had lain unmelted since time immemorial. The saint brushed away the glistening tear at the corner of her eye, and turned her gaze upon her somber attendant.
"[[Photius]], you may as well speak plainly. There is no need to wear such a look all the time. Say what it is that displeases you."
The young Vila, who had been chosen for her service for his skill in preparing elixirs, hurriedly lowered his eyes as he tried desperately to hide the thoughts that had just crossed his mind.
"No... Your judgment has ever seen through what lies hidden. How could one as foolish and lowly as I dare show the slightest disrespect toward your wisdom..."

Her words were greeted by a tinkling laugh.
"There you go again, Photius. You place such faith in those you deem wise that you would sooner persuade yourself to stop thinking.
You worry that the Pale Star King will learn the truth, and you question what I have done. These are all perfectly good questions.
But he will suspect nothing. Indeed, I trust in his mercy. What reason has he to doubt my tears?
On the one hand, the king of the Volkodlak would have the wind become a blade that cleaves bone. On the other, the Emperor of the Pale Star would have it become a holy sword to cleanse all that is corrupt.
Yet in the end, they both wish the wind to bend to their will, to follow the banners of the mighty and blow where they would have it go.
But Photius, the wind belongs to no one. So long as it continues to blow, none can know where it will carry itself."
The saint of Veneter let her gentle smile fade, her jade-green pupils reflecting the youth's still-innocent face.
"Best you learn from Glowatza. Pride and vanity are poisons that only bring ruin to a clan. Only the gentle wind can blow on forever." ==Gallery== Weapon Breezeborne Refrain 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Breezeborne Refrain 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Breezeborne Refrain Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Card Breezeborne Refrain.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46712931 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ===Chronicled Wishes=== {{Featured|chronicled=1}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Breezeborne Refrain |1_zhs = 柔风游弦 |1_zhs_rm = |1_zht = 柔風遊弦 |1_zht_rm = |1_zh_tl = |1_ja = 風に遊ぶ弦 |1_ja_rm = |1_ja_tl = |1_ko = 산들바람 활 |1_ko_tl = |1_es = Estribillo del Viento |1_es_tl = |1_fr = Refrain dans le vent |1_fr_tl = Refrain in the Wind |1_ru = Напевы нежного ветра |1_ru_tl = |1_th = Breezeborne Refrain |1_vi = Giai Điệu Gió Thoảng |1_vi_tl = |1_de = Lüftchen und Saitenspiel |1_de_tl = |1_id = Breezeborne Refrain |1_pt = Cordas Suaves |1_pt_tl = |1_tr = Rüzgarın Ezgisi |1_tr_tl = |1_it = Ritornello della brezza |1_it_tl = |2_en = Viper's Ballad |2_zhs = 蝰蛇的谣歌 |2_zhs_rm = |2_zht = 蝰蛇的謠歌 |2_zht_rm = |2_zh_tl = |2_ja = 毒蛇のバラッド |2_ja_rm = |2_ja_tl = |2_ko = 살무사의 노래 |2_ko_tl = |2_es = Balada de la víbora |2_es_tl = |2_fr = Ballade de la vipère |2_fr_tl = Viper's Ballad |2_ru = Баллада гадюки |2_ru_tl = |2_th = Viper's Ballad |2_vi = Ca Dao Rắn Độc |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Klagelied der Viper |2_de_tl = |2_id = Viper's Ballad |2_pt = Balada da Serpente |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Engereğin Şarkısı |2_tr_tl = |2_it = Ballata della vipera |2_it_tl = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|7.1}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|Fae}} {{Weapon Navbox|Bows}} [[es:Estribillo del Viento]] [[fr:Refrain dans le vent]] [[vi:Giai Điệu Gió Thoảng]]

For comparison, an increase to Attack DMG would increase damage by: (ATK × TalentDMG%) × PassiveDMG% Also note that the damage applies after each hit of multi-hit attacks, which are common on Polearm characters. ==Description== The whole world flocks to the commercial port of Liyue, much to the city's pride.
With the tides of people also come exotic treasures.
This spearhead is long and narrow like a needle, with a crescent-shaped blade extending from its base.
Once the bearer has grasped its elusive design concept, this weapon becomes far more destructive than its counterparts. Unlike the martial artists of Liyue, those from other lands are masters of the art of surprise, skilled at developing ingenious new tricks.
This weapon is designed to exploit fatal flaws. Like a needle, it slips between the gaps in an opponent's armor. Like the powers of music and love, it finds its way past people's defenses. The [[Blue-Eyed Spear Witch|designer]] of the Crescent Pike was said to be able to visualize the fatal flaws in life itself.
As if drawn by some mystical power, the pike would fly from her hand toward her opponents' fatal flaws.
"Perhaps all that lives waits willingly for death."
So thought the designer, who could see that which was fatally undefended in each living thing, yet had no such fatal flaws in her own life. Then she found music, and through music found love. And in love, she found her own fatal flaw.
In the end, the pain of finality, which pierced her heart like a needle, finally brought the witch to a realization:
"Fatal flaws are born of a fear of death. Fear of death is born of having things, and people, to care about." "Oh, how I wish to see him but one more time, that [[Parsifal|thief]] who can neither be caught nor killed."
"Oh, how I wish to hear his song but one more time. With the tides of people also come exotic treasures.
This compound bow may be small in size, but its unique design and superior craftsmanship have made it more destructive than most common longbows.
It is also harder to maintain than other bows. For it is not merely a weapon, but the culmination of the wisdom of a foreign kingdom. Made by a foreign scholar, this compound bow has been modified with a pulley.
The scholar had no heart for violence, and bore no desire to see blood drawn.
But mesmerized by the curve of the drawn bow, and the quiver of arrows in flight,
He was driven to transform the compound bow and make it more powerful. The scholar knew from the onset of his endeavor what his creation would become — a tool of war, that would bring nothing but death.
But he was lost in his pursuit to perfect both structure and materials,
And there was to be no stopping him as he fled this reality. Though one day the bow was taken up by a soldier, who promptly shot down a wild goose.
"This is the bow I seek"
Said the heartless soldier, commending the weapon in his hands,

Only issued to the best archers long in service of the order.
Expertly crafted, the oak frame provides superior strength while the addition of metal parts makes it easy to use.
The bowstring is enchanted with the secrets of alchemy and magic, granting protection to the fingers of the archer.
This bow serves as a reward to the worthy guardians of Mondstadt, and a fine tool with which for them to continue in their guardianship. The Knights of Favonius once had a formidable team of archer scouts known as the Outriders.
The team was founded by a [[Amber's Grandfather|mercenary leader]] from [[Liyue]], who passed on his lifetime's worth of knowledge to the Outriders. The tracking skills they acquired, along with the ability to sense when danger was afoot, were unique among all the knights.
Hence, the skills of the Outriders were invaluable to the Knights of Favonius. This lasted until the first of the Outriders, for reasons unknown to the Knights, ultimately left the order.
From that day, the Outrider team was a shell of its former self.
Its expertise was gone, though its structure and name have been preserved.
Nevertheless, [[Amber|there are still those]] who work tirelessly to maintain the dignity of the Outrider title. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Favonius Warbow Passive |caption = Passive: Windfall }} ==Gallery== Weapon Favonius Warbow 3D.png|Full Weapon - It is part of the [[Favonius Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Tile of Decarabian's Tower |bossMat1 = Heavy Horn |commonMat1 = Divining Scroll |ascendMat2 = Debris of Decarabian's City |bossMat2 = Black Bronze Horn |commonMat2 = Sealed Scroll |ascendMat3 = Fragment of Decarabian's Epic |ascendMat4 = Scattered Piece of Decarabian's Dream |commonMat3 = Forbidden Curse Scroll |bossMat3 = Black Crystal Horn }} ==Gameplay Notes== {{Transclude|Favonius Series|Gameplay Notes}} ==Description== A secret tome that belonged to the scholars of the Knights of Favonius. It holds the collective knowledge of the scholars.
It is inlaid with crystallized elements, which is what makes the Favonius Codex such a quality.
Not only because the elemental crystals are precious, but also because each Favonius Codex is hand-made.
Only scholars who have mastered the control of the elements can create such elemental crystals.The translation of this sentence is a rather poor one, omitting some key words that change the sentence; the original Chinese phrase, {{zh|只有真正掌握了元素的奥妙的学者}}, lends closer to "Only scholars who have truly unraveled the mysteries of the elements can refine such elemental crystals." When the Knights of Favonius was founded, the Dawn Knight [[Ragnvindr]] turned the aristocrats' indoor baths into a library.
In time, countless contributions from bards, scholars and travelers turned the library into the largest collection of literature in the northern half of the continent.
After all, songs are whisked away by the wind and wine's pleasure lasts but a fleeting moment. Only that which is committed to the page may sparkle and shine for eternity. Even so, the scale of the library's collection is now a fraction of what it was at its peak.The Chinese version specifies that the current library collection is one-sixth of its original size.
For sadly, the library once burned down in the "Great Fire of Fall Equinox" tragedy. There is a large sturdy door made of poplar wood in the library basement.
It is said the door predates the founding of the library and stood firm against the smoke and flames.
The truth is this door stood there long before the Knights of Favonius was ever founded.
The Knights of Favonius officially states that the restricted section of the library is housed behind the door.
But tales tell of a far more profound [[Imaginarium Theater|secret hidden within]]. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Favonius Codex Passive |caption = Passive: Windfall }} ==Gallery== Weapon It is part of the [[Favonius Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Fetters of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat2 = Chains of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat3 = Shackles of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat4 = Dream of the Dandelion Gladiator |bossMat1 = Chaos Device |bossMat2 = Chaos Circuit |bossMat3 = Chaos Core |commonMat1 = Recruit's Insignia |commonMat2 = Sergeant's Insignia |commonMat3 = Lieutenant's Insignia }} ==Gameplay Notes== {{Transclude|Favonius Series|Gameplay Notes}} ==Description== A heavy ceremonial sword of the Knights of Favonius. It is usually only issued after the approval of both the Grand Master and the Church.
The craftsmen in Mondstadt have achieved some results in elemental affinity by studying the ancient artifacts of Mondstadt.
This heavy greatsword is not only an honor bestowed upon a Knight of Favonius, but also the fruit of the hard work and skills of the guardians of Mondstadt.
It can channel elemental power with ease. Its bearer would do well to remember that destruction is but a means to an end, the end being to defend that which must be defended. Only a single-handed form of [[Rostam]] the Wolf Pup's Favonius Bladework survives today.
Another form has been lost to history: that of [[Arundolyn]], the Lion of Light, who could wield both a longsword and greatsword together in battle.
Because of the great strength needed, only those gifted with extraordinary strength could attempt this form. Thus, it soon died out. Close companions growing up, Arundolyn was from a long line of knights while Rostam was born to a peasant family.
Their childhood friendship was forged from a shared dream of heroism. As young men, they became fellow knights; as mature adults, one became Grand Master and the other his assistant. Grand Master Arundolyn was no Vision bearer. His formidable strength came from a mixture of natural gifts and intense training.
The Grand Master's strength was his pride, and the Grand Master was the pride of the Knights — nay, the pride of all in Mondstadt.
After Rostam met his fate, Arundolyn never displayed his strength again. For no longer was it a source of glory to challenge ferocious monsters. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Favonius Greatsword Passive |caption = Passive: Windfall }} ==Gallery== Weapon Favonius Greatsword 3D.png|Full Weapon - It is part of the [[Kunwu Series]] and the [[4-Star Bane Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Mist Veiled Lead Elixir |ascendMat2 = Mist Veiled Mercury Elixir |ascendMat3 = Mist Veiled Gold Elixir |ascendMat4 = Mist Veiled Primo Elixir |bossMat1 = Mist Grass Pollen |bossMat2 = Mist Grass |bossMat3 = Mist Grass Wick |commonMat1 = Divining Scroll |commonMat2 = Sealed Scroll |commonMat3 = Forbidden Curse Scroll }} ==Description== Rumored to be a legendary polearm of Liyue.
The polearm features a dragon motif that runs from handle to tip.
It used to have a dragon-shaped wooden sheath,
but now it no longer needs to contain its might.
It shall pierce through anything that stands in its way. It is said that when [[Kunwu]] forged this Pole, he used a dragon's spine for the haft and a dragon's claw for the tip.
Hence the weapon's body is unbreakable, while its tip is sharp beyond compare — and gleams with a dragon's malice. There once was a dragon slayer of unimaginable strength and courage, who defied the ocean's wrath and fought fiercely against the monstrosities it harbored within.
Many years after the dragon slayer had disappeared without a trace, the hopeless sound of a dragon's cry could still be heard resounding throughout the ocean. The dragon slayer became an urban legend. In the end, both the legend and the dragon-slaying polearm were lost.

Legend has it that the Eye of Perception was once upon a time as bright, clear, and smooth as a lake's surface, but became dulled over the passage of many years.
Folk records claim that on a still night, one can hear it make soft noises.
Sometimes it sounds like a mild breeze, other times like a flowering spring. They say that the Eye was an [[adeptus]]'s heirloom that was passed down in [[Liyue]] and eventually found its way into the [[Yun Family|Yun family]].In the original Chinese description, it is a relic of an {{Lang|adeptus clan/[philosophical] school|zh=仙家|zh_rm=xianjiā}}; notably, the Chinese term typically translated as adeptus/adepti is {{zh|仙人|rm=xianrén}}. Furthermore, it was not so much passed down in Liyue so much as it was sold in Liyue's marketplace, which is how it fell into the Yun family's hands.
Now one day, Yun was strolling about in the mountains, and there they happened to meet an exorcist named Huang, who had come to consult with the adepti.
Yun spoke with Huang enthusiastically and at length, gifted the Eye to Huang. When Huang frantically declined, Yun said this with a smile:
"This pearl is nature's very quintessence. Only one whose heart is clear can use it." Thanking Yun, Huang took the Eye and wore it on his person, and slowly made his way towards Liyue. Along the way, neither rain nor wind impeded him.
As one who sought after the path of the adepti, Huang wandered the land without rest. Thus, he would often be at the market to buy water and food.
The harbor-side streets were a morass of humanity. Yet Huang walked among them as if idle, and was never taken advantage of. Some were curious: how could this bookish exorcist take to the city like a fish to water, and never miss a step?
When asked, he replied: "This Eye trembles at wickedness, and helps me see which hearts are true." This Eye could reveal human hearts, though no one knows how it worked, causing many to fall back on folktales to explain it.
Some say that at midnight, you can dimly hear it call out like a mild breeze, or like spring water flowing between scattered stones.
Both are reminiscent of the murmuring of demons that feed on wicked thoughts, a common feature of the parables once told by mothers to their children in days long gone. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = It is part of the [[Gnostic Hymn 1 Series]]. ==Gameplay Note== *The passive stat type gained is constantly updated when the user of this weapon is on the field. When the user is switched to background, they will keep the latest updated type of stat until next time they are on the field. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Boreal Wolf's Milk Tooth |ascendMat2 = Boreal Wolf's Cracked Tooth |ascendMat3 = Boreal Wolf's Broken Fang |ascendMat4 = Boreal Wolf's Nostalgia |bossMat1 = Dead Ley Line Branch |bossMat2 = Dead Ley Line Leaves |bossMat3 = Ley Line Sprout |commonMat1 = Whopperflower Nectar |commonMat2 = Shimmering Nectar |commonMat3 = Energy Nectar }} ==Description== This crimson polearm has seen countless battles, and has borne witness to [[Unnamed Gladiator|a certain gladiator]]'s valor.
Its ice-cold tip was often drenched in the blood of its foes, to the thunderous applause of the crowd.
Bloodstained was the gladiator's fate, and freedom, so near yet so far, was often balanced on a knife's edge.
The dull sound of that crimson tip piercing flesh was many a battle's death-knell. As the gladiator's final performance ended, their master spoke up amidst the thunderous applause:
"The promised number has been met. You have done well, and are a warrior worthy of great renown."
"Consider this weapon to be a parting gift... Yet, would you not consider fighting on?"
"Continue your brilliant performance as a free person, for your glory and for mine. What say you?"
Many years past, and the beasts and men who fell to that spear grew too numerous to count.
The duelist's weapon became known as undefeated, but his heart belonged to his young master. As the gladiator's final performance ended, amidst thunderous applause,
His weapon fell to the bloodied sand as the [[Vennessa|red-haired maiden]]'s scorching blade pierced the old warrior's heart.
As he fell, despondent, he turned his eyes to his beloved master, his noble lord who cherished him...
"[[Eberhart]], Master Eberhart... Did my final performance please you?"
But his master's seat was empty, save for a wine goblet and silver platter, toppled in haste. "At first, I fought for myself, for blood and battle-lust."
"But since a time I know not when, I have killed for my master."
"Only for the sake of others can we fight like wild beasts without care."
"Someone like you, who fights for her people and not for herself... Surely, you understand this as well." ==Gallery== Weapon Deathmatch 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Deathmatch 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension ==Availability== *[[BP Bundle]] ([[Battle Pass]]' It is part of the [[Favonius Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Tile of Decarabian's Tower |bossMat1 = Heavy Horn |commonMat1 = Firm Arrowhead |ascendMat2 = Debris of Decarabian's City |bossMat2 = Black Bronze Horn |commonMat2 = Sharp Arrowhead |ascendMat3 = Fragment of Decarabian's Epic |bossMat3 = Black Crystal Horn |commonMat3 = Weathered Arrowhead |ascendMat4 = Scattered Piece of Decarabian's Dream }} ==Gameplay Notes== {{Transclude|Favonius Series|Gameplay Notes}} ==Description== A standard longsword wielded by the [[Knights of Favonius]]. It is usually issued after the approval of both the Master of the order and the Church.
The craftsmen in [[Mondstadt]] have achieved some results in elemental affinity by studying Mondstadt's Anemo.
This light and agile sword is not only an honor bestowed upon a Knight of Favonius, but also the fruit of the hard work and skills of the guardians of Mondstadt.
It can channel elemental power with ease. Its bearer could do well to remember that its sharp blade is intended for defending, not attacking. The traditional art of Favonius Bladework was originated by the childhood friend and spiritual counterpart of [[Arundolyn]], the Lion of Light, whose name was [[Rostam]], the Wolf Pup.
Legend says he could chop each drop of rain out of the sky, and that the wind from his sword dance could split the rose and extinguish the torch.
In this lies the essence of Favonius Bladework: light, swift, and precise in the defense of Mondstadt. At age of twenty-seven, Rostam received the title of Wolf Pup.
Knights of Favonius tradition dictated that the titles of [[Lion of the South|Lion]] and [[Wolf of the North|Wolf]] were reserved for those of great leadership potential. Such individuals would one day assume the position of Grand Master, devoting themselves to the leadership of a multitude of knights and the safeguarding of Mondstadt.
But though he fulfilled his duties faithfully, and devoted himself to Mondstadt, Rostam would not live to see that day. Since Rostam introduced the bladework style, no other practitioner has ever matched his legendary ability.
But his fervor, along with his will to protect Mondstadt, have stayed with the knights throughout the generations. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Favonius Sword Passive |caption = Passive: It is used in a ceremonial role at parades and reviews, but it is also a keen and mortal foe of monsters.
By studying the arbor that held firm in the wind, the craftsmen and scholars of [[Mondstadt]] would learn much of elemental affinities.
This sturdy spear not only holds a place of special honor among the Knights — it is also a crystallization of the hard work and artistry of the city's defenders.
With it in hand, they shall always remember to be disciplined, and to defend Mondstadt's freedom. Indeed, many people have used polearms of a kind as their weapons, using the reach advantage to supplement their lack of martial skill.
Even untrained plebeians could arm themselves with sharpened wooden sticks, and they would perhaps be a match for the steel of trained soldiers.
To celebrate the overthrow of the aristocracy, long stakes, flagpoles and pitchforks were stuck all over the greenery around the city. It was once required of all nobles to study the art of the sword, that they might grow in stature and wisdom.
In those days, the art of the spear was reserved for foreign gladiators and traitors.
But there was once a noble scion who wielded a spear.
They said that [[Eberhart]] would enjoy the night breeze as he caught the first drops of dew with his spear tip. An illegitimate child, Eberhart dreamed of recapturing the glory and pride of ancient nobility.
Yet, he needed greater power in order to destroy these rotten foundations. So—
Whether it was instigate [[Parsifal|his legitimate brother]] to pursue his dream of becoming a phantom thief, before deceiving him and forcing him to flee,
So that he might usurp that legitimacy,
Or whether it was pledging himself as a certain [[Blue-Eyed Spear Witch|spear-wielding witch]]'s disciple to learn the fatal loophole in her art,
All the better to slay her with... "So what if those who came after should despise me? I will do anything to achieve my goals." ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Favonius Lance Passive |caption = Passive: Windfall }} ==Gallery== Weapon_Favonius Lance 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon_Favonius Lance 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - He dreamed that he and everyone else had gone on a long, long journey,
Into [[Mondstadt|a land]] where green grass grew, and where soulful songs were sung.
He dreamed that he sang along with the gentle people of this land,
And danced in the skies with [[Dvalin|a dragon]] as beauteous as a jewel. When he opened his eyes, he was in the sky above [[Dragonspine|a mountain]] swept by roaring snowstorms.
The green, tranquil land had already been painted crimson by fire and blood,
And the song of that [[Venti|sky-blue bard]]'s lyre was almost drowned in the howling tumult.
And that bejeweled, lovely dragon, like a tender lover,
Had now pierced his neck through with its sharp fangs. "Farewell, [[Rhinedottir|Mother]]! My journey is ended."
"I shall sleep beneath this white, shining silver... and perhaps this, too, is good."
"Farewell, O lovely bard! And farewell, O lovely dragon!"
"Would that we had met in a different time and place,"
"To meet, to sing and dance together!"
So he thought most sincerely as he lay dying. "Now then, this great blessing that pulses through my veins,"
"And lovely sight of the dark universe that gave me birth..."
"They are now yours to inherit." ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Dragonspine Spear Passive |caption = Passive: Frost Burial - Everfrost Icicle Triggered }} ==Gallery== Weapon Dragonspine Spear 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Dragonspine Spear 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension ==Availability== *[[The Festering Fang]] [[World Quest]] reward. **Its [[diagram]] is also awarded at the end of this quest. *[[Forging]] ==Trivia== *This weapon's lore ties into the lore of [[Festering Desire]] since both weapons are made from the same dragon, [[Durin (Historical)|Durin]]. ==Video Guides== {{EVT |video = https://youtu.be/WPRkejMGyeU |caption = The Festering Fang Guide }} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Dragonspine Spear |1_zhs = 龙脊长枪 |1_zhs_rm = Lóngjí Chángqiāng |1_zht = 龍脊長槍 |1_zht_rm = Lóngjí Chángqiāng |1_zh_tl = Dragonspine Spear |1_ja = ドラゴンスピア |1_ja_rm = Doragon Supia |1_ja_tl = Dragonspear |1_ko = {{tt|용|龍}}의 {{tt|척추|脊椎}} |1_ko_rm = Yong-ui Cheokchu |1_ko_tl = Spine of Dragon |1_es = Lanza de Espinadragón |1_es_tl = Dragonspine Spear |1_fr = Lance Dosdragon |1_fr_tl = Dragonspine Spear |1_ru = Копьё Драконьего хребта |1_ru_tl = Dragonspine Spear |1_th = Dragonspine Spear |1_vi = Thương Long Tích |1_vi_tl = Dragon Spine Spear |1_de = Drachengratspeer |1_de_tl = {{lex|Dragonspine|de}} Spear |1_id = Dragonspine Spear |1_pt = Lança da Espinha do Dragão |1_pt_tl = Dragonspine Spear |1_tr = Ejdersırtı Mızrak |1_tr_tl = {{lex|Dragonspine|tr}} Spear |1_it = Lancia del Picco del Drago |1_it_tl = Dragon's Peak Spear |Transclude = Snow-Tombed Starsilver;2 }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.2}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|series=Dragonspine}} {{Weapon Navbox|Polearms}} [[es:Lanza de Espinadragón]] [[fr:Lance Dosdragon]] [[id:Dragonspine Spear]] [[ja:ドラゴンスピア]] [[pt-br:Lança da Espinha do Dragão]] [[ru:Копьё Драконьего хребта]] [[th:Dragonspine Spear]] [[tr:Ejdersırtı Mızrak]] [[vi:Thương Long Tích]] [[zh:龍脊長槍]]
