Gaining a new Sigil of Remembrance will refresh this duration for all existing Sigils of Remembrance. ==Description== "The west wind bears wine's fragrance away,"
"The mountain wind brings glad tidings new."
"The breeze from afar tugs at my heart,"
"It sings of my longing for you." Long ago, there was a [[Rostam|knight]] who was ever dour of countenance.
Only a certain song could ever cause his brow to unfurl,
And only a [[Signora|certain girl]] who sang that song in the square,
Could cause him to forget the great burden of his duty for a time. But at last, [[Cataclysm|calamity]] came upon this [[Mondstadt|land]].
The songs that had once flown joyfully in the wind were drowned by a [[Durin (Historical)|venomous dragon]].
In the wake of its earth-shaking footsteps, even the cries and the flames were ripped asunder.
The [[Barbatos|Anemo Archon]] heard their agony, though he had refused to rule.
But to protect his old friends' dream, and defend the wind-kissed fields of green,
He woke from his long slumber anew, and with the [[Dvalin|sky dragon]] in battle he flew...
The Knight and his knights also fought for their land. When the venomous dragon fell to ruin on the [[Dragonspine|ice-sealed peak]], the blue sky dragon fell asleep in the [[Stormterror's Lair|ancient tower]].
But the Knight was in the valley, spent of his life's blood, and as he fell, he could only think thus:
"She is abroad studying, so she should be well. But ah, how I wish to hear her sing again."
"At least [[Arundolyn]] and [[Roland]] are alright. When she returns, this calamity should have blown over." The songs in praise of the archon and tunes that recorded the battle of the two dragons were many, but all slowly became lost.
The song the girl loved to sing, too, changed upon her return.
"The dandelions carry in the summer wind,"
"Autumn brings the fragrance of grain."
"But no wind in any season on earth"
"Shall have you gaze upon me again." And after her voice and her tears had run dry, the girl swore to use her life's flame to cleanse the world's crookedness. ==Preview== {{Preview |file=Weapon Elegy for the End Passive Even those readers who have long reached adulthood cannot help but be absorbed by the innocent, naive little adventures portrayed within.}} '''Dodoco Tales''' is a 4-Star [[catalyst]] obtained from the [[Midsummer Island Adventure]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Boreal Wolf's Milk Tooth |ascendMat2 = Boreal Wolf's Cracked Tooth |ascendMat3 = Boreal Wolf's Broken Fang |ascendMat4 = Boreal Wolf's Nostalgia |bossMat1 = Dead Ley Line Branch |bossMat2 = Dead Ley Line Leaves |bossMat3 = Ley Line Sprout |commonMat1 = Damaged Mask |commonMat2 = Stained Mask |commonMat3 = Ominous Mask }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Dodoco Tales''' requires its refinement material {{Item|"Fragments of Innocence"}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Midsummer Island Adventure]] Event. ==Description== Legend has it that there is a group of islands somewhere far away in the middle of a foggy sea, and this place is called the [[Golden Apple Archipelago]].
They say that the cute and peace-loving Dodo Clan lives together on the many islands, and they have no troubles with the rest of the world.
The Dodo Clan are kind and playful creatures, and they love to tease each other and play with each other, and none of them ever get bored or sad.
"[[Dodoco]]!" they all call each other, and that means "the best of friends!" But just as dandelion seeds will one day leave the embrace of their stalk and go with the wind, every Dodoco will one day ride the wind and the waves, and travel to the wider world on an adventure, searching for a four-leaf clover.
Why must they do this?
It's because, having lived for a long time on the Golden Apple Archipelago, the Dodocos can no longer recognize each other. They're all "Dodocos," and they all look the same, after all! So there's no "you" or "me" for them at all!
But only the red, blazing four-leaf clover can let them know the true meaning of "Dodoco" and tell each other apart, thus allowing them to play freely with all their friends!
...At least, that's what my mom says, and she can do just about aaaanything!
So, in order to understand what makes a true "Dodoco," they leave their good friends and go to faraway places to make new good friends and become their "Dodoco," too!
They'll see all kinds of nice things, hear all kinds of interesting stuff, meet lots of friends... and one day, when their friends are looking at them, at a time when no one expects it — that's when the blazing, sparkling four-leaf clover will appear! And that's why when a furry Dodoco from the Golden Apple Archipelago tumbles into the sea or leaps into the wind before drifting far, far away, that means that a lucky child is about to meet their bestest friend ever!
This small, precious book was given by the freest mother in the world to the luckiest daughter in the world. It chronicles the countless adventures that Dodoco had before meeting her, and the adventures that she and Dodoco have had since — bigger and better adventures filled with sparks, splashes, treasures, and lots of friends! ==Gallery== Weapon Dodoco Tales 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Dodoco Tales 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Card Dodoco Tales.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/415713 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== * Obtained during the [[Midsummer Island Adventure]] event. ==Trivia== * [[Klee]] is seen wielding this catalyst in her [[Genius Invokation TCG]] [[Klee (Character Card)|Character Card]]. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Dodoco Tales |1_zhs = 嘟嘟可故事集 |1_zhs_rm = Dūdūkě Gùshì-jí |1_zht = 嘟嘟可故事集 |1_zht_rm = Dūdūkě Gùshì-jí |1_zh_tl = Dodoco Story Collection |1_ja = ドドコの物語 |1_ja_rm = Dodoko no Monogatari |1_ja_tl = Dodoco's Story |1_ko = 도도코 이야기집 |1_ko_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_es = Cuentos de Dodoco |1_es_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_fr = Contes de Dodoco |1_fr_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_ru = Истории Додоко |1_ru_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_th = Dodoco Tales |1_vi = Tuyển tập các câu chuyện về Dodoco |1_vi_tl = Collection of Stories about Dodoco |1_de = Dodoco-Geschichten |1_de_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_id = Dodoco Tales |1_pt = Contos de Dodoco |1_pt_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_tr = Dodoko Masalları |1_tr_tl = Dodoco Tales |1_it = Fiabe di Dodoco |1_it_tl = Dodoco Fairy Tales |2_en = Dodoventure! |2_zhs = 嘟嘟！大冒险 |2_zhs_rm = Dūdū! It is part of the [[Inazuma Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Mask of the Wicked Lieutenant |ascendMat2 = Mask of the Tiger's Bite |ascendMat3 = Mask of the One-Horned |ascendMat4 = Mask of the Kijin |bossMat1 = Chaos Gear |bossMat2 = Chaos Axis |bossMat3 = Chaos Oculus |commonMat1 = Old Handguard |commonMat2 = Kageuchi Handguard |commonMat3 = Famed Handguard }} ==Gameplay Notes== *At R1, approximately 286% additional Energy Recharge (386% in total) is needed to maximize the weapon's ATK increase bonus. *At R5, the same threshold is approximately 214% additional ER (314% in total). ==Description== The naginata was a lethal weapon by which scattered dross might be cut away.
And the one who wielded that naginata was [[Ei|one who guarded the path to eternity]]. When the one who stood high above the storm clouds looked upon the mortal world, which she so loved,
Seeing their shallow disputes and transient obsessions...
Such contentions stemmed from needless attachments and unchecked desire — both enemies of eternity.
The wild weeds that disturbed the unchanging world would be swept away by the lightning. "Well then — what sort of Eternity would [[Makoto|▉▉]]'s eyes reflect?" So asked the [[Yae Miko|clergy person]] who sloshed and drank wine with her under the sakura tree in that still-clear memory. What a pointless question. Though the answer she gave them was lost to the alcohol,
She had gained the answer countless times in those memories. One must thin fruits to improve their quality, and plants used in dyes must have their flowers pruned.
Not a single speck of dross could be permitted in an eternal paradise. "Ah, but even so..."
"Using that great blade of light to uproot all obsession and to eliminate the possibility for dreams to take root and wither by themselves..."
"A tranquil world that brooks no dispute, no gain, or no loss... It shall be an amnesiac world, lost to itself."
In the heart of eternity, those old friends still appear so clear and the scent of the sakura remains so fresh. But I will never forget you, just as I will not forget the things that were lost across the years.
After all... Having witnessed the [[Cataclysm|pitch-dark annihilation]] consume those precious to her,
How could she not see the absurd nature of life and death, yes, incomprehensible destiny itself, as her mortal foe?
But since no one can overturn the impermanence of the world,
and the barren nature of this game,
Then let the eternal euthymia within her heart carry forth into the [[Inazuma|nation she loves]]. ==Gallery== Weapon Engulfing Lightning Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Engulfing Lightning 3D.png|Full Weapon Weapon Engulfing Lightning 3D 2nd.png|2nd Ascension Phase Full Weapon Weapon Card Engulfing Lightning.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/770658 Weapon Details Announcement] Weapon Engulfing Lightning Full Icon.png|Full Icon (2nd Ascension Phase) Engulfing Lightning Passive Active.png|Visual Indicator for ER Passive after Burst ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ===Chronicled Wishes=== {{Featured|chronicled=1}} ==Trivia== * The Japanese name of the polearm {{Lang|Kusanagi no Inabikari|ja=草薙の稲光|ja_tl=Lightning of Grass-Cutting}} may be a reference to {{Lang|{{w|Kusanagi no Tsurugi}}|ja=草薙の剣|ja_tl=Sword of Grass-Cutting}}, one of the Three {{w|Imperial Regalia of Japan}}. In Shinto, the sword symbolizes the valor of an emperor and the nation. ** The mythology says the sword was found from the dead body of the great serpent {{w|Yamata no Orochi}} (which may have inspired the serpent god [[Orobashi]] in the game), who had been slain by the storm god {{w|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Susanoo no Mikoto}}. Susanoo then rescued and married the damsel in distress {{w|Kushinadahime}}, who is the goddess of rice plant, which in turn is traditionally associated with thunder and lightning. For example, ''[[Inazuma]]'' ("Lightning") literally means the "Spouse of Rice-Plant" (Susanoo in this case). ** According to legends, the sword was wielded by the hero {{w|Yamato Takeru}}, when one of his enemies set a fire to burn him in the midst of the field. He then cut down the grass with this sword to reverse the direction of the flames; one legend from the classic ''Nihon Shoki'' even says the magical sword moved autonomously for this action. Hence the sword earned the name Kusanagi ("Grass-Cutting"). * In the [[Version/2.0|Version 2.0]] Special Program, Xiao Luohao, Head of the Creative Concept and Writing Team, mentions that the weapon Ei used to kill Orobashi weighed thousands of tons. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Engulfing Lightning |1_zhs = 薙草之稻光 |1_zhs_rm = Tìcǎo zhī Dàoguāng |1_zht = 薙草之稻光 |1_zht_rm = Tìcǎo zhī It shines with a pure radiance like that of the moon, and just as ever-distant.}} {{Lang|'''Everlasting Moonglow'''|ja=不滅の月華|ja_rm=Fumetsu no Gekka}} is a 5-Star [[catalyst]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Coral Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat2 = Jeweled Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat3 = Jade Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat4 = Golden Branch of a Distant Sea |bossMat1 = Dismal Prism |bossMat2 = Crystal Prism |bossMat3 = Polarizing Prism |commonMat1 = Spectral Husk |commonMat2 = Spectral Heart |commonMat3 = Spectral Nucleus }} ==Description== The "pearl and waves" emblem of the [[Sangonomiya Clan|Sangonomiya]] is said to represent the waves that embrace Watatsumi,
And the bright pearls that can be found there. But some also say that it shows the jeweled wheel of [[Orobashi|Watatsumi Omikami]] keeping eternal vigil over the land of coral like the moon. In the dreams of the deep sea where sponges and coral dwell, in the depths where flowing clouds and ocean sands dance as one,
Undying hope would pass from generation to generation of those descended from their god — they who dreamed the same dreams as Watatsumi.
The colors of the skies are ever-changing, and the lights and shadows cast deep beneath the waves are of forms ill-defined...
Thus did the brilliant compassion that the dark ocean could not conceal diffuse in tranquil bliss. In those days, the first Divine Priestess once led her brethren with wisdom as precious as pearls,
And she selected clergy from amongst the people newly introduced to the sun, who aided the offspring of their god in comforting those for whom the light of day brought terror.
In latter days, the "[[Umigozen]]" who made the navies of [[Narukami Island|Narukami]] tremble would sing whale-songs alongside them,
And it was this symbol that they drew as they danced with the airborne kurage. Some years later, a [[Musou no Hitotachi|single bolt of lightning]] would reject the dream of the Watatsumi people.
Into the storm slithered the serpent, the lightning's ruthless glow to surely face...
But the children of the god and the shrine maidens, who had hearts of pearl, would not forget.
Countless tales, gratitude unnumbered, and that ring of ocean gems would forever be passed down,
And they would shine ever brighter and more beautifully for it. Whether it be the histories of the jeweled branches being torn or the birth of precious pearls,
Or the defeat of the [[Bathysmal Vishap|wicked creatures in the depths]] to bring sunlight to the pale nation beneath the waves,
Or how the young man who dreamed of standing atop [[Mt. Yougou]] came to have the name of an "[[Akuou|evil king]]," and had his great duel against the [[tengu]]...
All these would light up the hearts of the children of Watatsumi, like pearls from the heavens, like waves under the moon's glow.
They will carry the pain of loss away into the churning, salty waters, storing them within radiant pearls.
May the stories and sacrifices of the age of gods forever be handed down, along with this emblem of "pearl and waves." Even if the storm clouds should gather, and even if the violet lightning's ferocity be perilous and unpredictable,
The silver moon of Watatsumi shall still pierce through the clouds and scatter forth its light. ==Gallery== Weapon Everlasting Moonglow Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Everlasting Moonglow Upon it is inlaid a precious bead.
Buried in the depths, it has long been [[Oozing Concretions|drenched in darkness]], yet its luster endures, ever shining and glowing. In times long past, when a [[Cataclysm|dark calamity]] befell the [[The Chasm (Area)|vermillion valley]], countless Millelith soldiers sallied forth, heroism in their hearts.
Among all these valiant figures was a young archer who came from the mountains, and who would eventually remain in the depths, never to leave. "I am the daughter of the cliffs of Glazed Sand Crystal. My blood knows no fear."
"With so many Millelith willingly heading towards their doom in battle, it would be shameful for us mountain people to just stand by and watch."
"It may be natural that a cataclysm that we have not yet seen with our own eyes remains a foreign and abstract concept to us."
"Yet now that it stands before us, how could we do anything other than hold the line and do our duty..." The stubborn young woman stole the bow that belonged to her father, the tribal chief, by night, before following the Millelith as they sallied out.
As she steeled herself to never again see the light of day, the gem on the bow gleamed. "The dark bats she felled with every shot, the giant tortoise of the dark ooze, she nailed to the ground."
"The magnificent bow danced like the clouds themselves, its arrows' cold gleam tearing through blighted beast-flesh."
"No deluge of filth from the abyss, nor twisted demon from the warped depths..."
"No incomprehensible terror could make her heart quail, or force her to retreat." The people of the mountains would sing songs in praise of their daughter, though she of whom the songs spoke would never again return to them.
These tunes would change and shift with the passage of time like dawn's glow even to this day, yet she who owned the bow would never come back. "The only thing I truly fear is to be lost and forgotten."
"Should ill fate dictate that I am to be buried in some nameless place, do not forget me." ==Preview== {{Preview |file1 = Weapon Fading Twilight Passive 1 |caption1 = Passive: Radiance of the Deeps - Then, even the abodes of the [[Adeptus|adepti]] were not spared from the flaming beacons of war.
The lords once worshipped as gods fought for reasons their own,
Blood and fire, separation and betrayal. All the mortal world was stained. Those who lost everything in the tumult fled to the mountains, and there they begged for the adepti for shelter.
Doggedly pursuing those survivors were countless monsters who had long since lost their senses.
Their names were unknown, their numbers uncountable, they came on like a flood, destroying all in their path.
The other [[Mistress of Chenyu Vale|master]] that they had once revered had fallen, and their fierce roaring was, in truth, a final mourning howl. But the mortals then could not have known that the lord who once defended these mountains and waters had now passed,
And that all that stood between them and the onrushing deluge of catastrophe were a few vigilant yaksha who dwelled there.
After several days of fierce battle, white clothes had turned scarlet, and scarlet garments had been stained black. Still, the monsters came on like an endless horde... As this tale dates to days ancient beyond memory, the tale thereafter has branched out into many versions. Some say that just as all hung in the balance,
An [[Cloud Retainer|adeptus with azure and white feathers]] burst from the clouds like a descending gale,
Solitary, solemn, silent, in proud majesty and dignity did this being defend and administer the forebears,
Turning a hopeless cause around by vanquishing what had appeared a limitless tide of monstrosities... Others say that as things appeared most perilous, two jade-carved cranes hurtled from the skies above,
And in a hail of sigils did they subjugate countless evils as a chill wind disperses an expanse of cloud.
But when all turned to look, Lo! There were no cranes, but an adeptus airborne, folding fan in fair hand... Still others claim that so far above mortal reach was this adeptus's might that the ancestors but heard a crane's cry,
And before them, the endless monsters were as ash in an instant, like dust that dissipates in the sunlight... No matter which version of the tale, the people of [[Liyue]] thereafter would, when speaking of the adeptus [[Cloud Retainer]],
Would never fail choose their words with some respect. And as for what really happened back then... "Interested in such distant matters? You truly are a person of some leisure."
"Well, what with a similar mood being upon oneself, one shall speak of it."
"Now, one believes this tale may be naught but eight or nine hours in the telling, but you should pull a chair up, still..."
"...What? It is exceedingly rigid and heavy, and would probably hurt pretty bad if used as a cudgel.}} '''Dialogues of the Desert Sages''' is a 4-Star [[polearm]] obtained from the [[Alchemical Ascension]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew |ascendMat2 = Iron Talisman of the Forest Dew |ascendMat3 = Silver Talisman of the Forest Dew |ascendMat4 = Golden Talisman of the Forest Dew |bossMat1 = Feathery Fin |bossMat2 = Lunar Fin |bossMat3 = Chasmlight Fin |commonMat1 = Spectral Husk |commonMat2 = Spectral Heart |commonMat3 = Spectral Nucleus }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Dialogues of the Desert Sages''' requires its refinement material {{Item|"Exalted Earth"}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Alchemical Ascension]] Event. ==Description== The [[Seven Pillars|seven sages]] of [[King Deshret]] have long vanished, their deeds blown away by the winds, leaving behind only their names, carved in stone. Now, even these engravings have been eroded by the winds of time, turning into little more than golden grains of sand.
The right hand of King Deshret, the head of the Seven Sages, the minister of ministers — [[Heryshaf|The Goat King]];
The great bird winging skyward towards the sun, the King's soul — The saint [[Bennu]];
The lioness with a human head, the King's will — The saint [[Shesepankh]];
And the dragon who obtained the flesh and blood of the King, who never counted itself among the Seven — [[Apep|Al-Apep]].
The four named above have nothing to do with the story that follows. The [[Sobek|Crocodile King]] and [[Thoth|Ibis King]] were arguing ceaselessly, as ever, and that day the subject of their debate was the changing of things.
The Crocodile King sought a person who possessed mystic arts. That person had been blessed by an [[Oceanid]] who was staying there, and any liquid that passed through his hands would transform itself into an exquisite wine, perfectly proportioned.
The Ibis King brought forth another rare being, one who had accidentally touched the tomb and remains of an ancient god, and been cursed. Due to the curse, anything touched by both his hands would slowly become pure silver — after all, from today, we know that transformation into gold and [[Mora]] is the sole province of [[Morax|Deus Auri]].
The two of them bet on which effect would win out in the end. They also asked [[Hermanubis]] — who is the last of the Seven Sages to be mentioned — to make a conjecture as to the eventual result.
Hermanubis was a sage of the desert, and the leader of the priestly class. For this reason, he was both a warrior and a sage. And as the learning known as [[alchemy]] was passed down amongst humans, and he was well-versed in its secrets, asking him to judge was eminently reasonable. "Both forms of power clash directly, as sharp spears striking sturdy shields," spake Hermanubis, "And they must each yield unto the other, and take a step back. This is the principle of equilibrium."
In the end, the final result was that the cup became pure silver, while the silted water within became a fine liquor with suspended grains of silver. Yet the Crocodile King and Ibis King did not understand Hermanubis's admonishment, instead continuing their battle. In the end, they invented a strange summoning magic. And now, the two of them have traversed millennia to continue their battle upon the field of [[Genius Invokation TCG]]...
All of this is part of this version of the story of [[King of Invokations (Book)|"King of Invokations."]] ==Gallery== Weapon Dialogues of the Desert Sages 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Dialogues of the Desert Sages 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Card Dialogues of the Desert Sages.png|[https://x.com/GenshinImpact/status/1766312969841828164 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== * Obtained during the [[Alchemical Ascension]] event. ==Trivia== * This weapon is described as a {{w|caduceus}}, which refers to the staff of the god Hermes (Mercury) in Greco-Roman mythology. "O benevolent lord who leadeth us, should you still pity the children of humanity, then drink deep the wine in this cup."

It was an ancient era, before the [[Eclipse Dynasty|dark sun]]'s light illuminated the underground, and an ancient and glorious clan still ruled that vast kingdom.
The dogmatic priests convinced the muddle-minded king upon the throne that the remnants of the Crimson Moon in the sky ruled all,
For it is the color of the moonlight that flows beneath mortal flesh, and the darkness hidden within the bottom of the abyss shall too emerge from the Crimson Moon.
This being so, the king of humanity should take upon himself the name of the Crimson Moon, and by the light and flame of two worlds judge fickle fate.
Thus they yearned for transcendent individuals to build countless glorious towers, and prayed for the long-dead Crimson Moon to bring them salvation.
Until the astrologists branded as heretics glimpsed in the [[The Sign of Apaosha|inverted image]] of the [[False Sky|false sky]] the origin of all the world's fate,
Until the unquenchable flames of doubt and fury blazed across the dreamless realm like wildfire, finally burning to the moonlight-hued palace itself...

By the time of the blackened sun, the name of the Crimson Moon had long faded along with the crimson that had flowed. Only the epithet "Balemoon" remained to stain the lingering detritus.
Whether the unclean who suffered from the curse, or those unblemished ones not yet tainted by fate, none would again consider themselves a follower of the moon's remnants.
Few survived the utter destruction of their kind, hiding in the shadows where the sun did not shine, longing for the Crimson Moon to decree their desire for vengeance be repaid—

But the so-called repayment never came, and the dark sun fell to the same ignorance and arrogance.
When [[Cataclysm|destruction]] once again was nigh, only the mocking moonlight spilled forth upon the shadow of the sun, long burnt to ash.

"Fate, fate, O terrifying and pale fate, why must you abase yourself and submit to such a [[Heavenly Principles|tyrannical usurper]]
If the Balemoon's remnants had already sealed your doom, what meaning could be found in the blood vengeance of bygone days?
If the destiny [[Sonnet|she]] wove mocks us so, then let us mock destiny as loudly as we may
Until the last shadow of the ashen sun burns away the old world, until the Crimson Moon witnesses the immaculate dawn." ==Preview== {{Preview |file1 = Invitation to a Beheading Normal 2 Preview Max 2 stacks. |eff_rank1_var1 = 40 |eff_rank2_var1 = 50 |eff_rank3_var1 = 60 |eff_rank4_var1 = 70 |eff_rank5_var1 = 80 |eff_att1 = Energy |eff_att2 = Elemental Mastery }} {{Description|A prototype for a standard-issue weapon the [[Keqing|Yuheng]] commissioned from [[Blackcliff Forge]] after having analyzed the [[Guizhong Ballista|ancient mechanisms]] that protected the adeptal abode upon [[Mount Tianheng|Tianheng]].}} '''Cloudforged''' is a 4-Star [[bow]] obtained from the [[Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Grain of Aerosiderite |ascendMat2 = Piece of Aerosiderite |ascendMat3 = Bit of Aerosiderite |ascendMat4 = Chunk of Aerosiderite |bossMat1 = Ruined Hilt |bossMat2 = Splintered Hilt |bossMat3 = Still-Smoldering Hilt |commonMat1 = Recruit's Insignia |commonMat2 = Sergeant's Insignia |commonMat3 = Lieutenant's Insignia }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Cloudforged''' requires its refinement material {{Item|Cam and Cables of Law}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation]] Event. ==Description== The ancients say that the mountains of [[Mt. Tianheng]] are filled with gems, and the depths of [[The Chasm]] are rich with jade. The nation of a thousand hills has long been known for its abundance,
And its most critical mining and smelting facilities are located in [[Blackcliff Forge]], carved into Mt. Tianheng itself.

The Forge was constructed by excavating the mountains, with countless workshops, furnaces, and connecting tunnels blasted black by dust.
In the tumultuous years when the fires of war dyed the land red, this place was also where the ancestors of the mountain tribes sought shelter.
It is even said that long-forgotten passages are within, tunnels to an ancient underground realm that lies in the deep places beneath the earth...

According to the Stone Tablet Compilations, the first to carve the darkened paths through the mountains was the founder of the famous [[Yun Family|Yun family]] of [[Liyue]].
From that time hence, their clan, a house of smiths, has taken its place on the stage of history, regarded as honored progenitors by countless generations of artisans thereafter.

As for the stories of that person, the annals of history leave but a scant few lines—
"Such was Yun's ingenious craft that wood and bamboo might be carved into birds who would fly for three days without landing. Such were the works considered the apex of artisanry."

The study of mechanisms and the art of forging were all initially inextricably intertwined with the [[adepti]].
As such, the founder was oft regarded as an apprentice of the adepti, and the techniques employed by said founder considered adepti teachings.
The tale most widely known today is that this personage once fought alongside [[Rex Lapis]] on campaign,
And having accomplished much, was acknowledged by three adepti, one after the other, and was granted instruction in secret mechanical arts.

Legend has it that these divine techniques were such that even clouds could be plucked from the skies with which manses might be molded,
And even the rotting, wasting wood could be fashioned into moving birds and beasts, so alike to life as to confound the observing eye.
As such, the phrase "The Blackcliff, forged from clouds" has long been widely known in Liyue,
And poets and storytellers have long delighted in the contrast between the two images.
Though the legend of "cloud-forging" is a fanciful latter-day play on the family name "Yun" meaning "cloud,"
None dispute that the rest of the founder's life was dedicated to the Blackcliff Forge and the teaching of craftsmanship.

At life and legend's end, the founder ascended in heavenly light, becoming the guardian star of artisanry.
Still, legends are naught but legends. It was no adeptal art that built the Forge, nor was it woven of whisps of wind and cloud.
Instead, it was chiseled out one flake and one hammerstroke at a time, by the pouring sweat of countless ordinary artisans' brows over long centuries.
Deus Auri's contract never stipulated that mortal resolve could never surpass adeptal miracles, after all.

"Such was Yun's ingenious craft that wood and bamboo might be carved into birds who would fly for three days without landing. Such were the works considered the apex of artisanry."
"Yet Yun's life and career were spent working rock into workshops, and molding clouds into manses. Thus was the Blackcliff forged in Tianheng, that the well-being of all the people might be served."
"For thus Yun said: What is clever? And what is clumsy? Due to its greater weight than most ordinary weapons, it was named for {{sic|[[Kongamato|Kongomato]]}} the Mountain King.}} '''Fang of the Mountain King''' is a 5-Star [[claymore]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat2 = Delirious Desolation of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat3 = Delirious Demeanor of the Sacred Lord |ascendMat4 = Delirious Divinity of the Sacred Lord |bossMat1 = Ignited Stone |bossMat2 = Ignited Seed of Life |bossMat3 = Ignited Seeing Eye |commonMat1 = Sentry's Wooden Whistle |commonMat2 = Warrior's Metal Whistle |commonMat3 = Saurian-Crowned Warrior's Golden Whistle }} ==Description== In the heart of [[Scions of the Canopy|Huitztlan]] lies the [[Kongamato|"Mountain King" Kongamato]], a gargantuan creature like the mountains among which it sleeps.
In moments of searing pain, in half-waking frenzies, the Mountain King sees everything as a mortal enemy,
As if to prevent something from being stolen, it attacks all living things that approach without discrimination.
People say that Kongamato, who once protected the tribes, was driven mad by that [[Cataclysm|dark disaster]],
But they are never able to explain why the Mountain King, who ought not to be sentient, only attacks those who draw near.

Indeed, its sanity was lost long ago, back when its sharp fangs pierced [[Burkina|that person]]'s flesh.
Legends speak of the one who once made pacts with it, who hunted by its side,
But no matter how precious these memories were, they have now been lost to the Mountain King's long nightmare,
Even the name "Kongamato" itself has become unfamiliar to the ancient lord of the [[Yumkasaurus|Yumkasaurs]].

Yet, even so—
Even if it is unable to break free from the nightmare, it must at least protect the fire — though to whom it belongs, it knows not.
Even if who that person was, or why such a promise was made, have long been forgotten.

Even if the great body it was once so proud of continues to be wracked by burning agony,
Even if its now decaying frame still bears the imprints of unbearable shame,
Even so, it would never allow anyone to desecrate the life and fire that were once his.

For the giant beast, now lost to madness,
Despite its soul having been consumed by the filth of darkness,
This final shred of resolve it refuses to abandon, no matter what.

"I shall return the [[Turnfire]] name to the [[Night Kingdom|Night Realm]], in exchange for the final kindling."
"By past fuel, and present flame, life marches ever on."
"We will answer to the fire for all our deeds. Amidst the flames, we shall be reunited." ==Gallery== Weapon Fang of the Mountain King Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Fang of the Mountain King 3D.png|Full Weapon Weapon Fang of the Mountain King It is part of the [[Salutary Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Terror |ascendMat2 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Hesitance |ascendMat3 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Resolve |ascendMat4 = Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Splendor |bossMat1 = Ignited Stone |bossMat2 = Ignited Seed of Life |bossMat3 = Ignited Seeing Eye |commonMat1 = Sentry's Wooden Whistle |commonMat2 = Warrior's Metal Whistle |commonMat3 = Saurian-Crowned Warrior's Golden Whistle }} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Claymore Billet = 1 |Condessence Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Claymore Billet;Condessence Crystal;White Iron Chunk }} ==Description== ===Page #1=== Long, long ago, in what now is seen as an age of myth, when great [[dragons]] still soared above the [[Coatepec Mountain|canopy]],
There lived a [[Yupanqui|hero]] who — though he later came to be revered as the Firethief — was at that time still in his youth, and as reckless as a [[Halberd-Crest Bird]].
Born strong, brave, and boastful, he would roam the woods, challenging passersby to duels,
Yet he was easily defeated by a [[Och-Kan|half-human hero]], the follower of a [[Xbalanque|great warrior]], who with cunning footwork lured him into a mire. Seeing the young man in such a sorry state, the [[Lianca|archer]] could not help but laugh;
Of habit so stern and taciturn, you would not have thought that she would tease others so.
Half of shame, half of annoyance, the young man made up his mind;
He would follow these oddballs, if only to cover up the shame of defeat. "Hey! You aren't seriously thinking of taking on that... Uh, whatever it is, without me, are you?"
"Listen up, you lot! I am Yupanqui, and it is I that is destined to shake the very foundations of the... Wait, I haven't finished!" Many years later, whenever he thought back upon that journey, he couldn't help laughing at how awkwardly childish he used to be.
More than once did his failure to heed advice land him in great danger; more than once did his boisterousness earn him the [[Ixquieh|quiet artisan]]'s annoyance.
Though it is true that countless enemies fell to the swings of his greatsword, on balance, his contributions were still outweighed by the trouble he caused.
Despite this, the companions who journeyed by the warrior's side tolerated his youthful ignorance.
When his vision was taken by the [[Turnfire|fire of delirium]], it seemed to him that he heard the silent priest's words once more... "One day, you will understand why you embarked on this verdant path."
[[Malipo|"By past fuel, and present flame, life marches ever on."
"We will answer to the fire for all our deeds. This is your path, and yours alone."]] ===Page #2=== That was the age when the banners of all the tribes had returned to the corroded ruins of the [[Ochkanatlan|Cinder City]], when oaths had long since faded away.
Having gradually fallen into delirium, the [[Och-Kan|human king]] now babbled of his crazed obsessions, his eyes reflecting naught but fear.
Though still given to lament how the grand vision he had once held — of humans and [[dragon]]s coexisting — was now beyond reach,
Yet the [[Yupanqui|aging hero]] could not bring himself to rebel against his only surviving friend of old. In the end, he thought, the color would thus fade from all verdant paths.
In this way, passion is just like fire — despite regret and unwillingness, once extinguished, it is gone.
Just as there was no such thing as a flame that could itself be rekindled, so there would never be a path that was his, and his alone.
And thus, the disheartened old man silently accepted the idle position of ordnance officer for the [[Grand Alliance]],
Resolving never to interfere with his old friend's orders again, waiting only for the day that he would return to the [[Sacred Flame]]... Until, having saved the dragons from the [[Isle of Tozoz|shadow of the sword]], alone at night came the [[Scarlet-Eyed Youth|scarlet-eyed youth]] to pay a visit to the ordnance officer's abode,
With that zeal, at once both strange and familiar, he pleaded with the old hero to break the chains of the broken oath. Steadfast and taciturn, the old man did not answer him directly, only glancing at the dusty greatsword beside him.
In his eyes, over the long years glazed dull with gloom, a spark of fiery brilliance flashed up once more. ==Gallery== Weapon Earth Shaker 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Earth Shaker 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Card Earth Shaker.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/32371536 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== * [[Forging]] ==Trivia== *[[Mavuika]] is seen wielding this claymore in the [https://youtu.be/w1BaF4fd1UM Version 5.0 "Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn" Trailer] and in a cutscene during the corresponding [[Archon Quest]] in [[Chapter V]]: Act II - ''[[Black Stone Under a White Stone]]'', in which it is revealed she borrowed the weapon from [[Kinich]]. *The name of the weapon is a reference to the Sapa Inca Pachacuti of the Incans, known as "Earth shaker". It appears to be a relic from the [[Seelie]] of old.}} ''' Etherlight Spindlelute''' is a 4-Star [[catalyst]] obtained from the [[Clink Clank Clash]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Refinement== Refining '''Etherlight Spindlelute''' requires its refinement material {{Item|Golden Strings}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[Clink Clank Clash]] Event. ==Description== Beyond the ruins of the ancient palace and on the edge of the [[Nod-Krai|wasteland]] stands the tranquil sacred forest of Lake [[Amsvartnir]].
Legend has it that whoever breaks the golden branch in the forest will find the [[royal court of the Seelie]], which is concealed from mortal eyes during the day.
A kingdom of the past, it lies forgotten by both time and space, hidden in shadow where no heavenly light can touch it.
Its [[Koitar|owner]] has long departed, leaving behind nothing but a neglected courtyard and a hall stripped bare.
Yet, within the palace that should have been abandoned, a young woman's silent lament echoes across its walls.
"Once upon a time, the [[Heavenly Principles|titan craftsman]] of the skies once wove the destinies of all living beings, the golden harp their instrument of fate."
"That was the divine plan of the heavens. If it were followed, the entire world would usher happiness in."
"Yet even the ignorant can dream, and in her dream, a new future revealed itself."
"She saw men raise a [[Hyperborea|tower]] to the heavens, and from its heights, the tower's [[Anacharsis|apostle]] waging war against the sky..."
"She saw roaring beasts, each larger than a mountain, breaking free from the bonds of the earth..."
"She saw [[Three Moons|three moons]] casting their light upon the sea, a sight soon eclipsed by an [[Nibelung|ancient dragon]] rising like a tide."
"All that vanished the moment she awoke, as if it had never happened."
"All that remained was the indescribable glance from those star-like eyes."
"Was that love? Perhaps it was just delusion woven from hope, ambition, and a longing for death."
"But that matters not now, for their story has ended, and it became Elysium's finale."
"The chirping of insects on a long-gone autumn night is the chorus of exiles, singing mankind's most ancient song as they live out their plight..."
"They had lost the place of their bodies and souls, with nothing left but songs and memories of the homeland they once knew."
The last singers, the [[Koitar|first Seelie]], they played their final tune in the hall of [[angels]].
The [[Boreas|wolf]] who once broke into this place had long since departed. Only unfulfilled dreams remain, and continue to chase phantoms. ==Gallery== Weapon Etherlight Spindlelute 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Etherlight Spindlelute 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension It is part of the [[Frostmoon Scion Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== "Always remember, [[Avrelian]], my dear child — the one precious gift that fate has granted me."
"A thousand-year-old curse runs through your veins, and my only wish is for you to live a life of peace and joy."
"No matter what happens, you must never set foot in [[Nod-Krai]], and you must never be taken in by that fool's dream of 'Elysium.'"
"No earthly paradise under the moon has ever been built for mortals. All that the [[Heavenly Principles|Lord of the Sky]] has created has its boundaries."

On a snowy evening gently veiled in the aurora's light, the woman once worshipped as the [[Avrelian's Mother|Maiden]] had another glimpse of the dream foretelling the fate of her [[Hiisi Island|homeland]].
It had been many years since she bade farewell to that place. Yet, like the creeping frost, those deliberately forgotten whispers always found their way into her warm, quiet dreams, nonetheless.
Perhaps it was the new life growing within her that stirred the long-dormant visions, and now, those haunting, twisting phantoms grew ever clearer...

At first, they came to her as ceaseless nightmares, countless dreams that came and went endlessly in stifling, unyielding cycles.
The seeds of life, born not of natural evolution, fell from silver branches into the ruins of the desolate city.
Where featherless creatures, walking upright, enjoyed untold wisdom and the blessings it bestowed.
Then came endless greed and selfish desire, masked behind noble-sounding names.
And from these followed hatred, curses, betrayal, strife, plunder, slaughter, and kin turning against kin.
[[Unified Civilization|The cities scattered across the land]] pursued their own paths of good and evil while the [[Angel|divine envoys]] stood by in silence, watching all unfold.
Until the kings of the lands dared test the [[Celestia|eternal heavens]].
And only then did the great towers fall in flame, burying the cries of the slaves.

Like a fleeting shadow vanishing in a single breath, a dreamless dream stretched across a thousand years and then a thousand more.
A mountain of crowns in a secret place, beneath a [[Irminsul|withered tree]], forgotten by all.
But sometimes even the divine plan falters, and the [[Hyperborea|golden city]] that rose from the earth...
Could not satiate the hearts of mortals, aflame with desire.
Hearts swollen with ambition, drawn to [[Primordial Human|the vacant throne of the world]], longing to shatter the boundaries between man and god.
But like all tragic illusions, that boundless Elysium would crumble.
The [[Xiuhcoatl|draconic kings of flame]] plunged into the [[Abyss|dark abyss]], and the tides swallowed the white-stone empire whole.
The dying world was moving toward its end, with only the shadows of the past lingering in its halls.

Countless dreams steeped in blood, tears, and sin... Countless dreams, forever out of reach...
Years of division and hatred, carried across generations, cycling endlessly beneath the starless night.
And then, a voice unheard, yet more familiar than any she had known...
Whispered to her on the bitter end of darkness, with compassion soft and luminous as light.

"I shall bring an end to the warriors of this land and raise a boundless Elysium in their place."
"I do this not to be king, but so that no other can ever claim that role."

Her dream would always shatter just as it reached the moment of promise, and she would be pulled back to the shores of reality.
Accompanied by the pale morning light and the faint stirring of the life within her.
The young mother let out a quiet sigh as her fingers brushed against the silvery-white talisman resting against her chest.
Gazing upon the face of the one she loved beside her, the woman gently placed a hand over her belly and asked...

"My child, my dear child... why do you stir so?"
"Is it because you sense your mother's heart — are you afraid?" ==Gallery== Weapon Dawning Frost 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Dawning Frost 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Dawning Frost Wish.png|Multi-Wish Artwork Weapon Card Dawning Frost.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/41804877 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ===Chronicled Wishes=== {{Featured|chronicled=1}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Dawning Frost |1_zhs = 霜辰 |1_zhs_rm = Shuāngchén |1_zht = 霜辰 |1_zht_rm = Shuāngchén |1_zh_tl = Frosty Dawn |1_ja = 霜辰 |1_ja_rm = Soushin{{Assumed}} |1_ja_tl = |1_ko = 서릿빛 새벽 |1_ko_tl = Frosty Dawn |1_es = Escarcha del Albor |1_es_tl = Frost of the Dawn |1_fr = Frimas d'aube |1_fr_tl = Freezing Fog of Dawn |1_ru = Рассветный иней |1_ru_tl = |1_th = Dawning Frost |1_vi = Sương Mai |1_vi_tl = |1_de = Froststern |1_de_tl = Froststar |1_id = Dawning Frost |1_pt = Estrela Gelada |1_pt_tl = |1_tr = Sabah Ayazı |1_tr_tl = |1_it = Brina mattutina |1_it_tl = |2_en = Nocturnal Dreams |2_zhs = 深宵的胎梦 |2_zhs_rm = Shēnxiāo de Tāimèng |2_zht = 深宵的胎夢 |2_zht_rm = Shēnxiāo de Tāimèng |2_zh_tl = Late Night Conception Dream |2_ja = 胎動の夢 |2_ja_rm = Taidou no Yume |2_ja_tl = |2_ko = 새벽<->의 태몽 |2_ko_tl = Conception Dream of Dawn |2_es = Sueños nocturnos |2_es_tl = Nocturnal Dreams |2_fr = Rêve nocturne |2_fr_tl = Nocturnal Dream |2_ru = Сны глубокой ночи |2_ru_tl = |2_th = Nocturnal Dreams |2_vi = Giấc Mộng Đêm Khuya |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Nächtliche Träume |2_de_tl = Nocturnal Dreams |2_id = Nocturnal Dreams |2_pt = Sonhos Noturnos |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Gece Rüyaları |2_tr_tl = |2_it = Sogni notturni |2_it_tl = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|Luna II}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|Frostmoon Scion}} {{Weapon Navbox|Catalysts}} [[es:Escarcha del Albor]] [[fr:Frimas d'aube]] [[pt-br:Estrela Gelada]] [[tr:Sabah Ayazı]] [[vi:Sương Mai]]

Its keen point is constantly enveloped in a bone-piercing chill.}} '''Disaster and Remorse''' is a 5-star [[Polearm]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== In the [[Sal Vindagnyr|moonless city of snow]], the [[Imunlaukr|outlander warrior]] mourned a realm shattered, never to return. There, amidst the frost, he lay to rest in the ground a hope that would no longer bear fruit.
Leaving his unspoken longings alongside that lonely final mural, he began to wander the frozen plains, solitary and unmoored.
He believed that by casting [[Snow-Tombed Starsilver|his old greatsword]] into the deathly frost, he would be able to forget the weakness of days gone by,
throw himself into endless battle, and thus find solace and joy in the tang of iron and blood.
Yet, the warrior abandoned the hollow lie of his own despair at the very first moonfall after he left [[Mural Room|the great hall]] of [[Dragonspine|that mountain country]].

It was a fleeting moment of confusion and folly. All he wanted, by pure instinct, was to save [[Princess of Sal Vindagnyr|the maiden]] under attack.
He never again wished to see a head of silver hair, or a face as bright as the moon, buried under all that ice and snow.
This was a man who believed he had long broken the oath of a warrior, and who wished to spill his blood in conflict merely as a means of diversion.
He launched the astral silver lance, yet untainted by crimson, into the black tide of beasts with all his might.

in a strike that generations of scholars and bards thereafter would grant the appellation "dolorous."
Ancient songs tell of an outlander who roamed the frozen plains and brought calamity to a land of peace.
They sing of the man who, for the sheer joy of conflict, drove a cold tip of astral silver through the wind and snow and shattered the snow-covered mountains,
and in so doing, leveled three thriving kingdoms and consigned vast lands to utter desolation, leaving multitudes to wander the wastes.
The cries of the innocent, mourning the calamity wrought by that single blow, could be heard everywhere.

But the song is but a song. Before the bloodbath around him could even become legend,
the outlander stood dazed amidst the ruins, seeing nothing but fragmented glimpses of wind and snow.
His wayward spear had pierced the stone that held up the earth,
And the maiden that he meant to protect, too, had perished in the billowing darkness.
The survivors of the ruined lands saw the man named [[Imunlaukr]] as the sworn enemy of their fallen peoples,
hunting him without end.

For the warrior who claimed a craving to entertain the [[god]]s with strains of strife and blood,
The warrior who sank into despair but refused to accept his fate and sought redemption, yet ended up bringing on even more grief and sorrow...
This was the very moment he finally ceased longing for salvation and turned away from the life of a warrior forever. ==Gallery== Weapon Card Disaster and Remorse.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/45316230 Weapon Details Announcement] Disaster and Remorse Showcase.gif|Weapon Showcase ==Availability== ===Weapon Event Wishes=== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Disaster and Remorse |1_zhs = 灾悔 |1_zhs_rm = Zāihuǐ |1_zht = 災悔 |1_zht_rm = Zāihuǐ |1_zh_tl = Disaster and Remorse |1_ja = 災憾 |1_ja_rm = Saikan{{Assumed}} |1_ja_tl = Disaster and Regret |1_ko = 재앙 |1_ko_tl = Disaster |1_es = Desastre y Arrepentimiento |1_es_tl = |1_fr = Désastre et remords |1_fr_tl = Disaster and Remorse |1_ru = Бедствие и раскаяние |1_ru_tl = Disaster and Remorse |1_th = Disaster and Remorse |1_vi = Tai Họa Và Hối Hận |1_vi_tl = |1_de = Katastrophe und Reue |1_de_tl = Catastrophe and Remorse |1_id = Disaster and Remorse |1_pt = Desastre e Remorso |1_pt_tl = |1_tr = Felaket ve Pişmanlık |1_tr_tl = |1_it = Disastro e rimorso |1_it_tl = |2_en = Dolorous Stroke |2_zhs = 祸咎一击 |2_zhs_rm = Huòjiù Yījī |2_zht = 禍咎一擊 |2_zht_rm = Huòjiù Yījí |2_zh_tl = One Strike of Calamity and Blame |2_ja = 嘆きの一撃 |2_ja_rm = Nageki no Ichigeki |2_ja_tl = |2_ko = 재앙<->의 일격 |2_ko_tl = Blow of Disaster |2_es = Golpe de la calamidad |2_es_tl = |2_fr = Ruine et blâme |2_fr_tl = Ruin and Blame |2_ru = Погибель и вина |2_ru_tl = |2_th = Dolorous Stroke |2_vi = Một Đòn Tai Họa |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Verhängnisvoller Schlag |2_de_tl = Fatal Blow |2_id = Dolorous Stroke |2_pt = Ruínas e Culpa |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Hazin Son |2_tr_tl = |2_it = Colpo funesto |2_it_tl = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|Luna VII}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|series=Hexerei}} {{Weapon Navbox|Polearms}} [[es:Desastre y Arrepentimiento]] [[fr:Désastre et remords]] [[it:Disastro e rimorso]] [[ru:Бедствие и раскаяние]] [[tr:Felaket ve Pişmanlık]] [[vi:Tai Họa Và Hối Hận]]

It is part of the [[Kuznets Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Sword Billet = 1 |Rainbowdrop Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Sword Billet;Rainbowdrop Crystal;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Description== "Many long years ago, a member of [[fae]] royalty was worshipped in the shadows,"
"Until a cleansing hand came forth and slew them, leaving behind an ancient family name and forgotten remains."

Many such glorious epics are destined to be forgotten by time, the vanquished in the great game of survival.
The defeated young man laughed playfully, and swapped the honorifics and titles this way and that in his cryptic verse:
"O Pearl of the land of ashes, eminent lords and ladies of noble name, and esteemed worthies,"
"No grudge there is between you and I. This is a mere contest of strength, a dispute that breaks no boundaries."
"Though the outcome has been decided, I deem it best that we shake hands and make peace. Let us together cleanse this long road of filth and dust."
"Thus shall we earn the praise of the people who dwell amidst ashes, and those falsely beneficent lords shall hear of our deed and quail."
The young woman, lovely as a pearl, spoke forth with prideful face and menacing voice:
"Listen ye, soot-worms of [[Kitezhgrad]], humans whose sole trade is thievery."
"Remember this your loss, and depart according to your wager, before this lady's patience runs dry."
"Remember also this name, for it shall reclaim all that has been lost,"
"A day shall come when no one shall address the princess's descendants by their sacred name."

The young man paid the loss no heed, and indeed still saw fighting against injustice as a game. He grew ever more revered, and he lit the way towards equity.
The young woman, however, was nourished by brutality. She took for her title "[[Burner of Cities]]," and they propped her up as a ruler of destruction and emptiness.
At their next confrontation, what was once a petty squabble was now a battle for the safety of the citizenry,
And the tables were turned. Facing a rival with whom he shared mutual respect, the guiding one's compassion grew within him,
And where once he might have drawn upon old cunning or donned an irreverent look, he sought then to earnestly persuade:
"Your noble name has been woven by those with ulterior motives into a hollow banner, and they have led you to lose all."
"But people even now shall forgive you, in the name of the ashes, of Kitezhgrad, and indeed, of [[Snezhnaya]]."
But though she was beaten by one she had once vanquished, the young woman, yet beautiful as pearls, wore an arrogant look, her head yet held high.
"The Burner of Cities and her followers shall not submit to Snezhnaya, nor shall the land of ashes be the abode of those of royal descent."
"Base purveyors of false beneficence, opportunists of history... You are not fit to speak of conciliation and absolution."

A premediated third encounter became their final reunion.
The beating heart of destruction had turned into gunpowder, yearning to glimpse the end of all living beings via the train speeding toward the blast furnace.
The Burner of Cities and her followers plotted to destroy the [[Kresnik's Torch]]es, to have Snezhnaya play pallbearer to her ancient family name.
The guide, sharp as blade, the ancestor who founded the [[Luchkin]], led the people once more in thwarting the devices of those thugs.
As to that final contest, it has been interpreted countless different ways in the tales passed from generation to generation,
But only because the guide's followers continued to relive and recite the past over the centuries.
"Alas for his mercy, that instead aroused her rage. Alas for his benevolence, that failed to inspire repentence in those brigands."
"The battle at a stalemate, the two leapt upon the furnace, and together fell into the flames, and they perished, the good and the wicked both."

The gloom that had blanketed the tundra dissipated amidst the new dawn caused by that fall.
As to who had won or lost their previous encounters, the sharp blade and bright pearl of the land of ashes would tell not, for they now slumbered.
Darkness now covered their eyes. Fortunately, the prized sword that fell to the earth was rescued from the thin snow.
"O sword that keeps vigil over the people, let the path you guided us upon also be law that those who come after shall follow." ==Gallery== Version 7.0 Forgeable Weapon Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.}} '''Covenant of Frost and Snow''' is a 4-star [[Forge|forgeable]] [[Bow]]. It is part of the [[Kuznets Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Bow Billet = 1 |Rainbowdrop Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Bow Billet;Rainbowdrop Crystal;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Description== "The law shall uphold all the land under my jurisdiction, and thus shall it be blessed with peace."
"These laws shall sanction all who commit acts of terror and disrupt order."
"We shall conquer humanity's weaknesses and bring peace to these long borders."
"We shall forsake useless emotions and keep our frozen hearts beating."

One who wishes to lead the [[Transportation Bureau]] and maintain law and order within [[Snezhnaya]] must heed the admonitions of centuries past,
And lend one's ear to the tale of the leader who ultimately forsook emotion and kindness, pointing a bow at those they once called friends.
It was a contest between order and chaos, a battle between defense and destruction, and after that, a showdown between old friends.
In those days, the young human was not the head of the Transport Bureau, and the pale [[fae]] served not yet at the [[Burner of Cities]]' side.
Both lamented the world's injustice and mourned its futile struggles, and because they shared ideals and evenly matched strength,
They found kindred spirits in each other — an enviable thing in a time when humans and fae could not see eye to eye in the least.

"Chaos can breed hope, and new buildings can be fashioned atop ruins. Destruction is not utterly without cause, but is meant to bring about golden rebirth."
"Yet brutality has left this nation wounded and scarred. Those who live within its bounds need a new order and new laws."
Thus, the two diverged over the moral path this land should take. Human and fae, in the end, should struggle to share the same ideals.
And though they had parted ways with no desire to meet again, the justice of order cannot by its nature coexist with the brutality of destruction.
The clash, therefore, was a foregone conclusion. The human led the [[Chicota]], becoming the guardian of law and order, standing guard amidst snow and frost,
While the fae became "the wise one," using the name of old royalty to incite the masses who longed for destruction, all in the name of rebirth.

This went on till white dew had condensed into frost, and that frost had turned into dew, the metal bells ringing thrice, then thrice again.
As the train passed the white birches, and both [[The Guiding One|sharp sword]] and [[Burner of Cities|bright pearl]] fell, the long and drawn-out conflict would finally come to an end.
The fae fled, covered by brigands, but could not deceive the chief of the Chicota.
The bow was raised, the arrow nocked, and he locked onto his target without pause, until the fae, as if realizing something, turned and looked upon him.
The human could not help but ask himself: When had this ever-beating heart grown as frigid as the frost and snow?
But he could still see the guiding one's fall as if it were still before his eyes. He knew all too well how dangerous his friend of old was.
The words that had come along with the bow rang in his ears still: "This bow is not given unto [[Eprokin]], but rather to the guardian of order."
One ought to harbor sorrow and compassion as a person, but the leader of the Chicota must judge in accordance with the law that governs all living beings.

Many humans in years past would dedicate their lives to the moving trains, consigning themselves to the endless blizzards.
And the promise he made when he received the bow and arrows became the oath that generation after generation of Chicota heads would swear upon taking the seat.
"We shall conquer humanity's weaknesses and bring peace to these long borders."
"We shall forsake useless emotions and keep our frozen hearts beating."
"Let me exercise humility in my authority, and keep my conscience as I fulfill my duty."
"Let cowardice and arrogance be far from me, that I may never betray this oath." ==Gallery== Version 7.0 Forgeable Weapon Description.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46150565 Weapon Details It is part of the [[Kuznets Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Borderland Catalyst Billet = 1 |Rainbowdrop Crystal = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Borderland Catalyst Billet;Rainbowdrop Crystal;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Description== [[Domovoy]] born with statures considered small even amongst their people struggle to find a place to belong, no matter where they go.
The beasts would mock their hunched forms, and humans were wary of their strange appearances.
Must they be forced to bear the sin of betrayal from birth on account of their kin who had pledged loyalty to humans?
Was there no other way to carve out a place for oneself beyond becoming a jester to be made sport of, thus ingratiating oneself with the powerful?

"Know this, my lost kin: the realm that the [[Tsaritsa]] has created has no place in it for us."
"Seek vengeance against humanity, for their sowing of discord and their preposterous plays at power. We [[fae]] were the original masters of ice and snow."
The hunchbacked Domovoy was thus accepted by the [[Burner of Cities]] and her servants, and he served beneath the banner of old royalty.
Alongside the brutal wolf-fae, he listened to the sublime edicts of the wise one, and from then on followed the banner of destruction and emptiness.

This spy by the Burner of Cities' side was one day discovered, and they subjected him to alternating rounds of torture and persuasion.
"You ingrate! We accepted an outsider such as you, only to be rewarded with treachery."
"Yet a lost lamb may still be forgiven and granted blessed protection, so long as they speak truth from now."
Yet for all the rattling of the chains or all the honey poured on, silence was the answer the executioners received.

Humiliated and infuriated, the brigands moved to execute the Domovoy cruelly, all the better to warn others of a traitor's fate.
Faced with the axe and eternal slumber, the figure that once stooped now unveiled his commanding height.
"Ideals that conceal selfishness and hatred should not be allowed to deceive the world. The scheme to destroy the Torches must be stopped for justice to be done."
"The Domovoy serve not humanity, but the future of all life. Away with all this ostentation! Death shall taste sweet to me."

Through echoes in the relics he left behind, he was able to bring a secret report to his companions, along with the bright future he would not live to see.
This then was the tale of the Domovoy, a fleeting existence in transient time, whose steadfastness earned not a single chronicler's plaudit.
Only the guiding one resolved to settle his grudge, for the sake of their friendship, for his long years of persistence,
For the oath of loyalty he had made and not forgotten, for he had never once lost his way amidst the long, cold nights.
"To bow and scrape is not my way. One day, the world shall know,"
"That even at the last, [[Varenukha]] did not bend." ==Gallery== Version 7.0 Forgeable Weapon Description.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46150565 Weapon Details Announcement] ==Availability== * [[Forging]] ** Its diagram is obtained from [[Kuzmichev]]. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Echoes of the Heart |1_zhs = 寸心余响 |1_zhs_rm = Cùnxīn Yúxiǎng |1_zht = 寸心餘響 |1_zht_rm = Cùnxīn Yúxiǎng |1_zh_tl = The Heart's Lingering Sound |1_ja = 胸中の谺 |1_ja_rm = Kyouchuu no Kodama |1_ja_tl = Echoes In One's Heart |1_ko = 충성의 메아리 |1_ko_tl = |1_es = Eco del Corazón |1_es_tl = |1_fr = Écho du cœur |1_fr_tl = Echo of the Heart |1_ru = Отголоски сердца |1_ru_tl = |1_th = Echoes of the Heart |1_vi = Dư Âm Tấm Lòng |1_vi_tl = |1_de = Echo des Herzens |1_de_tl = Echo of the Heart |1_id = Echoes of the Heart |1_pt = Ecos do Coração |1_pt_tl = |1_tr = Kalbin Yankıları |1_tr_tl = |1_it = Echi del cuore |1_it_tl = |2_en = Echo of a Vow |2_zhs = 誓言的回音 |2_zhs_rm = Shìyán de Huíyīn |2_zht = 誓言的回音 |2_zht_rm = Shìyán de Huíyīn |2_zh_tl = Echo of an Oath |2_ja = 誓いの残響 |2_ja_rm = Chikai no Zankyou |2_ja_tl = Lingering Sound of a Vow |2_ko = 맹세의 메아리 |2_ko_tl = |2_es = Eco del juramento |2_es_tl = |2_fr = Écho d'un vœu |2_fr_tl = Echo of a Vow |2_ru = Эхо клятвы |2_ru_tl = |2_th = Echo of a Vow |2_vi = Tiếng Vọng Lời Thề |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Echo des Schwurs |2_de_tl = Echo of the Oath |2_id = Echo of a Vow |2_pt = Eco de um Juramento |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Bir Yeminin Yankısı |2_tr_tl = |2_it = Eco di un giuramento |2_it_tl = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|7.0}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|Kuznets}} {{Weapon Navbox|Catalysts}} [[es:Eco del Corazón]] [[fr:Écho du cœur]] [[it:Echi del cuore]] [[vi:Dư Âm Tấm Lòng]]

It houses a game much beloved by the kings of the sands.}} '''Clash of Kings''' is a 4-star [[Catalyst]] from the [[Battle Pass]]. It is part of the [[Gnostic Hymn 3 Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats}} ==Description== It is said that in a faraway realm on the far side of the starry sea, or perhaps in an ancient era of which history and legend alike failed to record, there was a hidden world known to none.
As with all legends, this one began with a world that was formless and void, with neither beginning nor end. Only the three gods existed, passing the time amidst the infinite void in boredom.

The first god claimed the name "Valor," and he possessed unlimited power and divine might. None in the universe might best him in battle.
The second god was named "Cunning," possessing unlimited wisdom and guile. Since time immemorial, no one could see through his schemes and plots.
Perhaps personality differences were to blame, or perhaps they needed to pass the time, but these two gods would fight endlessly, having never stopped since the world's creation.
Yet, neither intelligence nor strength had any practical meaning in a world with neither beginning nor end, and such, too, proved the contest between the two gods.
Neither could achieve victory, but neither was willing to admit defeat. This, then, was when the third god, "Nature," finally spoke up with an interesting idea.

"Let us create a new world, upon which we shall use dice to determine the winner."
"For even gods cannot change the outcome of the dice."

Though no one knew what transpired in the middle, the three gods reached an agreement in the end and put their disputes aside to partake in this grand plan.
The God of Valor smoothed the lands and turned them into a square chessboard, and he made mountains and rivers in imitation of the past world.
The God of Cunning then carved chess pieces of various forms. Angels, humans, Jinn, monsters. He made the dragons and magical beasts also, those impelled by the God of Nature.
Thus were the heavens and earth opened, and thus did things come to pass.

Thousands of days and nights flew by. Countless adventures and legends took place in their turn upon this tiny, newly built world.
One thing, however, remained consistent — only the dice in the gods' hands could decide the fate of the world.

Even a seasoned Hero, though he could crush city halls of refined gold in but a single casual swing,
Was undone by the Dark Lord despite a valiant struggle, thanks to the vagaries of horrendous dice throws.

"Blast! Well, at least I came prepared for this eventuality. Valor's Hero comes equipped with divinely bestowed armor that has a mortal save. I shall revive the Hero and roll again..."
"Yes, but you'll have to pass a check before that. With the Hero in a weakened state, he is vulnerable to a spiritual attack from the magical sword that contains the soul of the previous Dark Lord..."
"Excuse me? Where is that coming from? I've never seen it in the rules, ever!"
"The Tome of Universal Laws, Page 83. You must have failed to read the updated version, I see."

"Damn you, [[Thoth|Ibis]], and your godforsaken, backstabbing ways!"
"Oh, come now, what are you saying? Deception is part of war... If you must lay blame anywhere, blame your failure to upgrade the Soul Barrier ability. Alright then. The Hero is now a piece on my side, and I'd quite like him to turn on his companions and..."
"Hold. The Hero is under the control of the previous Dark Lord's will. As such, he should technically not belong to the current Dark Lord's forces. Rather, he should be a monster under Nature's command..."
"What? What is this nonsense!?"
"Aha, you see? Now that the shoe's on the other foot, you've flown into a panic, too."
"With the Hero being seized by the previous Dark Lord, even the current Dark Lord was not his match. The ancient demons thus regained control of the world... The adventure ends here. Neither of you achieved victory, alas."
"That said, not all is lost. Let us create a new batch of adventurers and start another round... We have endless days and countless nights ahead of us, and shall naturally need adventures unnumbered to pass the time." ==Gallery== Weapon Clash of Kings 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Clash of Kings 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - It's favored by the [[Millelith]] officers.}} '''Halberd''' is a 3-Star [[polearm]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Mist Veiled Lead Elixir |ascendMat2 = Mist Veiled Mercury Elixir |ascendMat3 = Mist Veiled Gold Elixir |ascendMat4 = Mist Veiled Primo Elixir |bossMat1 = Mist Grass Pollen |bossMat2 = Mist Grass |bossMat3 = Mist Grass Wick |commonMat1 = Whopperflower Nectar |commonMat2 = Shimmering Nectar |commonMat3 = Energy Nectar }} ==Description== The polearm is a powerful weapon even in the hands of the unskilled, because "the longer, the mightier."
Adding an axe on the tip renders it somewhat unwieldy, but adds slash capabilities. This makes it better suited to complex battle scenarios.
The axe-mounted polearm — the halberd — is preferred by warriors of great strength. It has also come to symbolize the honor and bravery of Millelith officers.
Though peace prevails in the Liyue Harbor of today, the sight of brave warriors with halberd in hand is a ubiquitous one on the city streets. Each Millelith squad was led by an officer who would fearlessly charge ahead. They were the first line of defense for their comrades in dangerous territory.
But it was not through bravery, loyalty, and self-sacrifice alone that they were able to protect their comrades. For they were also formidable fighters, their skills honed over years and years of drilling.
Any foe who dared approach knew that the sight of the halberd-holding officers of the front line spelled almost certain doom for them.
And when the soldiers of the Millelith assumed a tactical formation, it was the cornerstone of their fearless officers that made them impenetrable as a rock formation. ==Preview== {{Preview |file = Weapon Halberd Passive |caption = Passive: Heavy }} ==Gallery== Weapon Halberd 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Halberd 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension ==Availability== *Randomly found in [[Chests]] of Exquisite or higher quality in [[Liyue]]. ==Trivia== *The Chinese name of the polearm {{Lang|Yue mao|zh=钺矛|zh_tl=Great-axe polearm}} is a reference to {{Lang|Yue|zh=钺}}, a type of ancient Chinese battle axe. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Halberd |1_zhs = 钺矛 |1_zhs_rm = Yuè Máo |1_zht = 鉞矛 |1_zht_rm = Yuè Máo |1_zh_tl = Battle-Axe Spear |1_ja = 鉾槍 |1_ja_rm = Bousou{{Assumed}} |1_ja_tl = Halberd Spear |1_ko = 미늘창 |1_ko_tl = Halberd |1_es = Alabarda |1_es_tl = Halberd |1_fr = Hallebarde |1_fr_tl = Halberd |1_ru = Алебарда Миллелита |1_ru_tl = Halberd of the Millelith |1_th = Halberd |1_vi = Thuẫn Kích |1_vi_tl = Halberd |1_de = Hellebarde |1_de_tl = Halberd |1_id = Halberd |1_pt = Alabarda |1_pt_tl = Halberd |1_tr = Baltalı Mızrak |1_tr_tl = Axe Spear |1_it = Alabarda |1_it_tl = Halberd |2_en = Heavy |2_zhs = 沉重 |2_zhs_rm = Chénzhòng |2_zht = 沉重 |2_zht_rm = Chénzhòng |2_zh_tl = Heavy |2_ja = 過重 |2_ja_rm = Kajuu |2_ja_tl = Overweight |2_ko = 무게 |2_ko_tl = Weight |2_es = Pesado |2_es_tl = Heavy |2_fr = Écrasement |2_fr_tl = Crushing |2_ru = Сокрушающий удар |2_ru_tl = Smashing Hit |2_th = Heavy |2_vi = Trầm Trọng |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Schwergewicht |2_de_tl = Heavyweight |2_id = Heavy |2_pt = Pesado |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Ezici |2_tr_tl = Crusher |2_it = Ponderosità |2_it_tl = Weightiness }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}} ==Navigation== {{Weapon Navbox|Polearms}} [[es:Alabarda]] [[fr:Hallebarde]] [[id:Halberd]] [[ja:鉾槍]] [[pt-br:Alabarda]] [[ru:Алебарда Миллелита]] [[th:Halberd]] [[tr:Baltalı Mızrak]] [[uk:Алебарда]] [[vi:Thuẫn Kích]] [[zh:鉞矛]]

It is part of the [[Dragonspine Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Fetters of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat2 = Chains of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat3 = Shackles of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat4 = Dream of the Dandelion Gladiator |bossMat1 = Chaos Device |bossMat2 = Chaos Circuit |bossMat3 = Chaos Core |commonMat1 = Whopperflower Nectar |commonMat2 = Shimmering Nectar |commonMat3 = Energy Nectar }} ==Gameplay Notes== {{Transclude|Dragonspine Series|Gameplay Notes}} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Northlander Catalyst Billet = 1 |Crystal Chunk = 50 |Starsilver = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Northlander Catalyst Billet;Crystal Chunk;Starsilver;Mora }} ==Description== When the [[Princess of Sal Vindagnyr|daughter of the priestess of Vindagnyr]] was born beneath this white tree,
The kingdom in the verdant mountain was filled with joy when she received her blessing. Surely, the blessing of [[Sal Vindagnyr]] would be everlasting,
Just as [[Frostbearing Tree|the undying silver-white tree]] whose roots pierced the earth.
That was the hope of [[Ukko|those who wrote the annals]] of that mountain kingdom.
Those who had recorded the tales of countless people and events believed this in their hearts,
That the beauty and skill of their princess would be as eternal and pure as the moonlight. When the [[Skyfrost Nail|nail that froze the world]] descended suddenly,
And that tree, too, would be shattered by it,
That girl took the most complete branch,
Thinking to breathe new life into the tree that once overshadowed a nation.
But in the end, the grafted life could not flourish.
The cutting snowstorm eventually covered the moonlight like a curtain of countless blades... A long, long time later, yet still long ago —
When the deathmatch between the [[Durin (Historical)|dragons of darkness]] and [[Dvalin|wind]] was decided at last,
When corrosive blood stained the [[Wyrmrest Valley|ashen valley]] red,
The tree, at last, remembered that it had not died with that entombed city,
And it extended its greedy roots towards the warm ichor that irrigated the land. Because a [[Traveler|certain someone]] poured out a [[Crimson Agate|crimson essence]] upon it,
The tree that should have long died remembered its past,
And bore a single fruit from the coalescence of all its might... Here, for those who dwelt in my safe shadow, for the priests who eulogized me,
For that lovely maiden who oft painted upon my form,
For all the happiness they could not possess — I enjoin them all into this crimson, icy fruit. To the one who can render recompense upon this poisonous world shall it go,
And may they carry my innocent, bitter fruit as they enact justice. ==Gallery== Weapon Frostbearer 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Frostbearer 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension ==Availability== *[[Forging]] **Its [[diagram]] is obtained from upgrading the [[Frostbearing Tree]] to level 10. ==Trivia== *This weapon is the only one in the [[Dragonspine Series]] that is exclusively obtained through Forging. *The phrase "priestess of Vindagnyr" in this weapon's lore is likely a misinterpretation on the English translation's part. It drips with a shriveling venom that could even corrupt a mighty dragon.}} '''Festering Desire''' is a 4-Star [[sword]] obtained from the [[The Chalk Prince and the Dragon]] event. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Fetters of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat2 = Chains of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat3 = Shackles of the Dandelion Gladiator |ascendMat4 = Dream of the Dandelion Gladiator |bossMat1 = Heavy Horn |bossMat2 = Black Bronze Horn |bossMat3 = Black Crystal Horn |commonMat1 = Recruit's Insignia |commonMat2 = Sergeant's Insignia |commonMat3 = Lieutenant's Insignia }} ==Refinement== Refining '''Festering Desire''' requires its refinement material {{Item|Festering Dragon Marrow}} instead of identical weapons, 4 of which can be obtained through the [[The Chalk Prince and the Dragon]] Event. ==Description== This was a story from long ago... [[Abyss|Unborn life, unfulfilled wishes]],
Tragic dreams at the edge of the [[Sea of stars|universal darkness]] that could never come true,
Indwell my body, and descend unto [[Teyvat|this world]]. Then, my lovely children,
Like rainwater flowing into creeks, and plants growing towards the sun,
Go unto a lovely place, and display your own beauty there with pride. This is a memory, a memory that a child named [[Durin (Historical)|Durin]] had of [[Rhinedottir|his mother]]... "Thank you, Mother, thank you."
"You gave me wings to soar and a mighty form."
"Mother, I wish to go to a land of lovely songs,"
"I will tell them about you, Mother, and about everyone else."
"I shall tell them that the place where I was born is beautiful." ==Lore== According to [[Albedo]] in the {{Quest|Festering Desire (Quest)}}, Festering Desire was a sword created by a blacksmith who disappeared shortly after its creation, with the weapon becoming lost to time and eventually ending up in the possession of [[Treasure Hoarders]]. When stolen goods were reclaimed from a group of Treasure Hoarders by the [[Knights of Favonius]], this sword was rediscovered. As no one came to claim it, Albedo investigated this sword and discovered its true origins: the sword's blade had been coated with a powder made of [[Durin (Historical)|Durin]]'s remains - notably his eyes, claws, and scales. This infused the weapon with Durin's power, but also its corruption, cursing the sword and making it unusable by "ordinary mortals," as the corruption might seep through the handle and infect the body of the wielder. Albedo goes as far as considering this sword a living being, and theorized that this curse might be the reason behind its creator's mysterious fate. The [[Traveler]] is unaffected by the curse, as they have the ability to purify [[Abyssal Corruption|abyssal corruption]], as demonstrated when they purified [[Teardrop Crystal|Dvalin's tears]], hence why Albedo entrusts the sword to them for experimentation. The sword is eventually cleansed of its corruption by the end of ''[[Raiders Amidst Snow Mist]]'' thanks to the Traveler purifying it over time, although some of its sheer power is lost when it is transferred by accident into the [[Resurgent Cryo Regisvine]] during ''[[Uninvited Guests]]''. Albedo extracts the rest into a bottle during ''[[Afterword (The Chalk Prince and the Dragon)|Afterword]]'', gifting the now safe sword to the Traveler as a memento of their research. ==Gallery==
